Route Description: Route to Isbert’s Dam then through tunnel (bring torch) and a climb up to Fontilles and then up to the Col.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.

Route Description: Impressive coastal views. Lunch at watchtower.
Directions: Meet in public car park opposite fish market.

Route Name: Castell de Castells circuit to Arc de Xorquet
Route Description: A walk from Castell de Castells which takes you up to the Aixorta ridge but below the summit. You head in the direct of Tarbena before returning in an anti-clockwise direction, passing by the Arc de Xorquet. And then a gentle return back down into Castell de castells. Fantastic views of the coast and Cocoll along the way.
Directions: Take the CV720 from Parcent and Benichembla to Castell de Castells. In the village, immediately opposite Hotel Serrella (on the RHS) turn L. After 20 m. turn L again into Calle Jose Antontio and then almost immediately L again down a ramp into the signed parking area.

Route Description: Most of the walk is on mozarabic trails.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel; park in the large public car park on right opposite Bar Restaurante Jalisco.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Name: Coll de Rates circuit from Jalon via Camí de les Passules, Barranc del Negre & Camí de la Pansa
Route Description: From Jalon via Camí de les Passules, Barranc del Negre and Coll de Rates to the Mirador Coll de Rates, and returning via Camí de la Pansa, Azagador de Mestre, and Camí de les Passueles.
Directions: Park and meet by the Tourist Information Centre in Xaló / Jalón, opposite Casa Aleluya.
Restrictions: Not Saturdays; parking is impossible due to the rastro.

Route Description: Gentle stroll through the fruit fields.
Directions: Park and meet by the Tourist Information Centre in Xaló / Jalón, opposite Casa Aleluya.
Restrictions: Not Saturdays; parking is impossible due to the rastro.

Route Name: Alt del Ample Circular Walk from Jalon
Route Description: A magnificent walk around the upper slopes of Alt del Ample with panoramic views of surrounding sierras.
Directions: Take CV749 Jalon to Bernia road. Parking area 600m past Km1 marker on RHS, just after cemetery road, opposite side to a large villa."
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A very pleasant walk, mainly on good tracks and paths with some on quiet roads. Lovely views from the highest point.
Directions: Meet in the centre of the village near the school. From Ondara, take second exit from roundabout & then next right (one way).
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A varied walk with all the hard work done before a late lunch stop. Mix of old and new trails, with a steep ascent out of Castells and then a fairly easy descent back to the cars along good tracks with some lovely views along the way.
Directions: Bridge at km30 past Benichembla on Castell de Castells road CV720.

Route Name: Ѧ Caballo Verde Ridge West to East Ѧ
Route Description: Circular route to the ridge before descending under Penyo Roig toward Fleix and back to Benimaurell.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel; park in the large public car park on right opposite Bar Restaurante Jalisco.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Description: Descent into Barranco del Infierno, walk in to Cova Santa. Out of Barranco to join route back under the Caballo Verde ridge. Back down to Fleix. Some scrambling, some rough tracks, some loose scree. But worth the effort.
Directions: Park opposite the school in the new car park in Fleix at km 5.9 on the CV721.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Description: Steep climb, ridge walk and back along top of barranco del Infierno around east end of Carrasca. Wonderful views, rough terrain. Some animal tracks and no tracks at all.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)

Route Name: Les Planises from Jalon (Spring Leg Stretcher)
Route Description: Interesting walk through barrancos Maserof and Baron. Excellent opportunity for observing flora and fauna.
Directions: Take the Jalon to Bernia road, the CV749 and at approx. 2km, park on the left. Take care coming from Jalon because you will need to cross the road on a bend.

Route Description: Ascend through Barranco Segues, over Col de Garga and return via mix of mozarabic trails and interesting river bed. Can be scratchy and some scrambling.
Directions: Bridge at km 30 past Benichembla on Castell de Castells road CV720.

Route Description: A walk mostly on good tracks and paths.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Not Saturdays; avoid weekend of Perello fair - around 20th November
Lunch_break notes: Optional lunch in "Bar Capri" after the walk.

Route Name: Javea circuit to the Eye of Montgo
Route Description: A circuitous route over varied terrain, a hidden rugged ridge with short sections of scrambling (some steep & unavoidable) lead to a civil war memorial. Easier paths cross Les Planes then a steep ascent to the Eye, with extensive views & time to explore the cave. Return by little frequented paths down the southern slopes to visit the Ermita Sant Llucia.
Directions: From roundabout junction of CV-735 on W side of old town, go towards Denia for 500m. At pedestrian crossing, turn L into Cami de Santa Llucia (stone cross at junction). In 200m, parking area at bend, for Ermita.

Route Name: Almadic Ridge from Valley Floor & Cocoll Summit
Route Description: Initially good road that rises steadily to the cliff base, that leads to the ridge. Dramatic climb that includes scrambling and use of ladders & chains to reach the ridge above. Please note once into the ""Lara Croft"" section of the climb you are committed to getting to the top as there is no alternative route. Continues along ridge to head of the valley, fire lookout, before return to start point.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, Benichembla on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells

Route Description: A short but challenging walk on the flanks of Mediodia using defined footpaths and quiet roads as a pre-lunch or short work out. Once above valley level the views out across the valley are excellent.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Hills around Aldea de las Cuevas
Route Description: Gradual climb up hill to Tossal Verde with great views, and back to the Urb. and around the water deposito, all on good tracks.
Directions: From the roundabout at Benidoleig take the Pedregeur Road. After 50 mtrs take a sharp turn right up a steep hill. Follow this for 2 km, past a row of houses near the top, past the bins util you come to the Estate Office. Take the 4th turn right after the office - signed "Pool Bar". Park in car park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Route starts along a barranco to Cova Llebeig (smugglers' cove), along the undercliff, passing caves to the mirador above, Playa de Moraig (Cumbre del Sol). Option to visit the rock formation at Cala Moraig - and returning along the same route. Some parts of the route, e.g. the barranco and the steep decent need care.
Directions: Take road from Moraira to El Portet for approx. 2 km. At El Manet sign turn left into Camino de la Viuda and carry on for approx.2 km.

Route Name: A Shorter version of Sender Del Seguili
Route Description: This is a short version of the recently created walk PR-CV 445 around the hills above the village of Benidoleig. The walk has wonderful views down into the Orba valley and out to the coast. Along the route there are information boards identifying flora and fauna and historical landmarks. A couple of steep sections of path but the going is good.
Directions: Park on Carrer Racona in Benidoleig near the school. Meet by the side of the road. If coming from Ondara direction go straight through at the roundabout.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times
Lunch_break notes: We will have a banana stop but will be back in the village by lunch time so no need for sandwiches. Lunch is available in the bars in the village for those wishing to stop.

Route Name: Vall de Ebo to the Pla Dels Corralets
Route Description: A varied walk with views around the Val D’Ebo. The walk takes in a series of gentle climbs on roads, tracks and paths with a couple of minor but easy clambers over some rocks on a marked Y/W path. The return is on a Mozarabic path which has been disrupted by wild boars so is rough underfoot in places (mountain terrain).
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Cim del Penyalba to Cim del Monduver traverse Ѧ
Route Description: A traverse along the fine open undulating ridge of the Serra de Monduver. Going over Cim del Penyalba, a number of minor tops and Monduver, via 3 or 4 sections of scrambling, some of which is unavoidable. Visiting the Cova de les Mallaetes & Forat de la Drova. Returning via paths and tracks along a traverse of the southern flanks. The terrain is very varied with fine views. Some passages are exposed and some short sections are steep and difficult!
Directions: From Gandia on CV-675 at roundabout at eastern end of village with “BARX” sign on it. Take first exit onto Carrer Pep Andres Garba and turn right immediately and right again. Pass the Ajuntament De Barx office, then turn right into car park.

Route Name: Ѧ Segaria summit from the West Ѧ
Route Description: Very pleasant sections at the beginning and end of this walk but with a tough and challenging ascent over rocky ground to the summit. Some interesting scrambling. Not for those that don't like a little exposure.
Directions: Take the CV729 to Benimeli. In centre of Benimeli turn off the CV729 at brown sign “Pou de Baix”. Park near outdoor piscina.

Route Name: Cova Tallada Circuit from Denia gun club
Route Description: Civil war memorial, windmills, Cave with views through roof & optional (if sea is calm) exploration inside (torch useful not essential). Coastal traverse & 16th C-watchtower. The route has a short off piste section (a little scratchy), steep descent (one section with chain) & a little bit of exposure. Wonderful views.
Directions: At km 5.6 on CV736 near top of pass between Denia & Javea, turn W towards Montgo onto gravel track with grass island. Follow track 500m, R at barrier, to reach the open plateau of Gun Club car park.

Route Description: A new combination of Olta routes, starting at the station and featuring the 3 Olta summits with the descent from the 3rd peak via ""the gully"" Wonderful coast and mountain views.
Directions: Aitana Commercial Centre Car Park. From the N332 follow yurn off sign to Calpe station and almost immediately take a left turn to the Aitana Commercial Centre car park and park at the far end
Restrictions: Wednesdays only

Route Description: A long ascent from the start to the top of Soldettes ridge. From there several shorter ups and downs, bringing us back to Soldettes ridge to then take a little used path directly off the ridge to the east. A final, smaller ascent back to the town.
Directions: From Teulada direction, take first left after the viaduct into Carrer Sant Josep/Calle San Jose. Cross bridge and follow road around to right. Park on right or left of road near allocated parking marked in red and childrens playground.

Route Description: Just in the MS range we have three circular routes that join in the middle, on the south flank of Puig. Splendid views towards the coast. Ruins, a prehistoric, once inhabited cave, and a spectacular barranco that coax us along this very pretty walk.
Directions: Km6.1, CV758. Parking here on road and just up the lane off the road. From AP7 leave at jct 65. Take CV 767 to Finestrat and from Finestrat take CV 758 towards Benidorm
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Pedro Paseo from Ermita de San Juan
Route Description: Explore a little walked area of the countryside on the outskirts of Calpe. We meet at the Tennis Club and drive in convoy from there to the start the walk at the Ermita de la Cometa.Varied tracks and stunning views to the coast and mountains
Directions: Park and meet at the Ermita de Sant Joan de la Cometa, in Partida Tosal de la Cometa, Calpe..
Reservation notes: RESERVATION REQUIRED; WhatsApp leader to reserve place.

Route Name: Barranco de la Canal and d'Alambra Castell (optional)
Route Description: Small amount on roads but mainly on marked tracks and paths albeit a short stretch of path is a little rocky underfoot.
Directions: Meet at Xiringuito La Verdala in the Passage Atzaneto where there is ample parking. (The Xiringuito is available for refreshments for early arrivals and at the completion of the walk.)

Route Description: A circular walk mainly on tracks, some quiet roads and a short path. Wonderful views.
Directions: Park at edge of village near swimming pool. From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d'Ebo. Continue past Vall d'Ebo to Alcala de la Jovada.

Route Description: Small amount on roads but mainly on good marked tracks and paths albeit a short stretch of path is a little rocky underfoot. Lovely views, particularly from the castle.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Description: This is the perfect walk for walkers wishing to remain on good surfaces. The walk is entirely on country roads so is perfect for those wishing to look around at the wonderful scenery and the many places of interest in the high Alcala valley.
Directions: Park at edge of village near swimming pool. From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d'Ebo. Continue past Vall d'Ebo to Alcala de la Jovada.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Ѧ La Muntanya Sud d’Alcala and part Forada Ridge Ѧ
Route Description: A lovely walk over wide tracks, a short section of road and marked paths. The walk visits a nevera, a landing strip and part of the Forada ridge with splendid views of the Gallinera valley
Directions: Park at edge of village near swimming pool. From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d'Ebo. Continue past Vall d'Ebo to Alcala de la Jovada.

Route Description: A circular walk linking Tollos, Alcala de la Jovada and Beniaia. Mainly on tracks, some quiet roads and a little on paths. Hopefully another Almond Blossom Walk
Directions: Take the CV720 through Castell de Castells and past Famorca, Facheca and soon afterwards there is a turn to the right to the village of Tollos. Take this and just before reaching the village park on the right in the car park behind a small recreation area.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Los Tres Pueblos reversed and extended
Route Description: A circular walk linking Tollos, Beniaia and Alcada de la Jovada. Mainly on wide clear tracks, some quiet roads and a short distance on paths. No steep ascents or descents and not scratchy.
Directions: Take the CV720 through Castell de Castells and past Famorca, Facheca and soon afterwards there is a turn to the right to the village of Tollos. Take this and just before reaching the village park on the right in the car park behind a small recreation area.

Route Name: Serra d' Aixorta - Barranco Mates , Raco de la Figuera and Font Major circuit
Route Description: A beautiful tranquil walk on good paths with excellent views of Guadalest reservoir , down to the coast ,across to Aitana and varying interesting features
Directions: From Guadalest on CV70 through Benimantell and turn R at next junction to Beniarda. Drive through village and continue (narrow road ) and turn L near PR finger post, cross ford ,ignore R fork ,reach next junction and park at LHS. (alternately take CV755 from Callosa then turn R at sign for Embalse de Guadales and follow along RHS of reservoir to reach PR sign and turn off )

Route Name: Pas Del Badall, Cova Dalt &The Almadic Valley
Route Description: This is a demanding walk with an exhilarating and challenging starting ascent using steel ladder steps and chains, with a squeeze and scrambling as you go through the Badall. The walk then follows the undulating Cordilleras Rim track with fabulous views, and then on to the Cathedral like Cova Dalt before descending steeply back into the Almadic Valley on the return journey.
Directions: From Parcent enter the roundabout at Benigembla and take the Castels exit and go over 1 speed ramp. Then turn left into Carrrer de la Foia. The car park is immediately on your right. Car share to starting point 4k.

Route Name: Barranco de Famorca high level circuit
Route Description: Exploration of a scrambling barranco followed by a high level mountain return and easy descent to the village.
Directions: Take the CV720 from Parcent and Benichembla to Castell de Castells. In the village, immediately opposite Hotel Serrella (on the RHS) turn L. After 20 m. turn L again into Calle Jose Antontio and them almost immediately L again down a ramp into the signed parking area.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: A circular route under Caballo Verde with some unexpected lush bamboo tunnels to add extra interest.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells

Route Description: A climb to the summit of this majestic mountain with a shorter route back avoiding the barranco descent and car shuttle. Route on well defined paths with a short section of scrambling with exposure.
Directions: Bar/Rte Venta Strambotik on CV800 (ex N340) Campello to Alcoy, km6.5. To get there take AP7 to junction with CV800 and then head towards Alcoy for about 3km. Bar is on right hand side of road. (or go via A70 Junction 5 toll free)

Route Description: This walk contains the last two summits of the Serra Xorta. A gentle climb up to Font Roja then a ridge walk then back down to another font and back to village.
Directions: Km 5 on CV 754 Fachega to Quarrotondeta road
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Javea La Plana from Restaurante Amanecer
Route Description: A delightful coastal walk with some fine views. Our route takes us to the windmills, down to the port, up to the lighthouse then along La Plana, past the monastery and back to the restaurant.
Directions: Restaurante Amenacer. Take the CV 736 Javea to Denia road and at the top turn R (L if coming from Denia into Carretera de Sant Antonio and signed “Cap de Sant Antonio and Els Molins”. Restaurant is on the RHS.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barranc d'Infern, Juvees d'Alt i la Carrasqueta.
Route Description: A scramble down the river bed, up steps to abandoned hamlet then up to the ridge for lunch.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Malla de Llop circuit from Castell de Castells
Route Description: An alternate route up and along this mighty ridge , a tough ascent rewarded by spectacular views - an exhilarating and classic mountain walk
Directions: Take the CV720 from Parcent and Benichembla to Castell de Castells. In the village, immediately opposite Hotel Serrella (on the RHS) turn L. After 20 m. turn L again into Calle Jose Antontio and them almost immediately L again down a ramp into the signed parking area.

Route Description: Up to the refugio, into the Maserof barranco and around Marnes. Some cross country parts but lots to see.
Directions: 1 km after Pinos restaurant on Benissa-Bernia road (CV749) take right hand junction just over bridge towards Marnes. Park after 200m.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Interesting route on mainly good forest tracks and paths. Constantly changing views towards Serra de la Forada above Gallinera, Cocentaina, and Serra de Serrella.  The walk involves a long and punishing climb.
Directions: CV-713 from Tollos. CV-712 from Val D'Ebo before turning onto CV-713 after Alcala De la Jovada. Park in square.
Restrictions: 27/05/2026: Section between Beniaia and Margarida is currently impassable; following on from the major fire in the area three years ago, the majority of the trees have now finally fallen completely blocking this section of the route.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Segaria Ridge Scramble from the West Ѧ
Route Description: Classic summit via a demanding ridge scramble. Paths around western end and up onto ridge crest. Along northern flank to the notch. About 1km of rugged scrambling and boulder hopping over summit to col beyond. Return along northern flank to regain ridge crossed earlier. Descend directly to Benimeli. Tremendous views and airy situations
Directions: Cami Olivers signed Pou de Baix from the CV-729 from Beniarbeig to Sagra. Use car park or at roadside

Route Name: Eye of Montgo from Las Rotas
Route Description: A challenging walk with interesting features and beautiful views. The route includes all types of terrain including scrambling, chains, tricky rocky paths, wide gravel paths and even some tarmac. We start by viewing the sea caves from the viewpoint above (not going into the caves), then going steeply up to the windmills, continuing up to the Eye of Montgo and back again via the coastal watchtower.
Directions: Turn off the Denia-Javea CV7361 onto Carretera Provincial del Barranc del Monyo towards Las Rotas (Les Rotes in Valencian). Continue 1.7km until you reach the car park "Aparcamiento Les Rotes" on your right hand side.
Restrictions: Cave access is restricted from June to October,and during the Easter period.

Route Description: A stiff climb to an Ermita, extensive views to Valencia, spectacular barranco descent then climb up the awesome barranco Tarongers. Good paths throughout.
Directions: From CV 700 roundabout enter Bocairent, cross the bridge. Take second Right into Av. d'Espanya & park near Bar Xam
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Alcala de la Jovada - Moorish Circuit
Route Description: A circular walk with varied paths and tracks through interesting and historic countryside with extensive views
Directions: Park at edge of village near swimming pool. From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d'Ebo. Continue past Vall d'Ebo to Alcala de la Jovada.

Route Description: Steady climb to the trig point with good views.
Directions: Meet at the Bar Venta La Parra km 187.3 on the N332, about 1km south of Gata de Gorgos, just past the Repsol Garage on the right, coming from Gata.

Route Name: Loma Larga (not the ridge) and Serra de la Venta circuit from Pinos
Route Description: A walk on the flanks of the hills around the Marnes Valley. 90% wide track and good single track giving opportunity for lovely views throughout the route.
Directions: 1 km after Pinos restaurant on Benissa-Bernia road (CV749) take right hand junction just over bridge towards Marnes. Park after 200m.

Route Description: An easy way to reach the summit of the Mediodia ridge. A Bob Stansfield route re-visited.. The walk along the forest road above the Ebo descends gently to the start of our ascent which is across an easy but steep open hillside. Views from the summit are outstanding. The descent may be scratchy but the final return of 2km is on our outgoing slightly uphill track.
Directions: Summit of col between Pego and Vall d'Ebo on track side opposite windmill.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Tossal del Moro from Gata de Gorgos
Route Description: Walk through the village then on mostly good tracks and paths with a short but steep accent to the summit of Tossal del Moro with its ruined look out for super views.
Directions: Gata de Gorgos car park at the end of Carrer Pou de Pedreguer opposite Restaurant Trossets
Restrictions: Wednesdays only
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Maigmó Circuit via the Via Verde
Route Description: A spectacular walk mostly on good tracks which avoids the summit. Bring torches if you do not like the dark.
Directions: Motorway service centre on A7 from Alicante to Alcoy km 482. Next to Exit to Agost. Meet in Cafe "Mesón Maigmó". Convoy to start of walk after optional coffee.

Route Name: Tossal Verd via Orbeta from Benidoleig
Route Description: The route starts in Benidoleig and takes us above the village before navigating on good paths towards Orba. On reaching the area of Orbetta we gently climb to the ridge above the Orba valley and head back towards Benidoleig. It is here that there are a couple of sections where the path has been cut back (Oct 18) but could still be a bit scratchy. You will be greeted by great views of the Orba valley and beyond along this hidden gem of a route.
Directions: Enter Benidoleig using the CV 731 or CV733. At the roundabout in Benidoleig take the exit between the Farmacia and the shop 'Grupo Marco'. Follow the road for 200m and park in the small car park on the left. If this is full there is parking on the side of the road on the right.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Interesting circular walk from just outside Elda of an iconic mountain “El Cid” . It has a similar appearance to the table top mountain of Cape Town.
Directions: Plenty of parking at the side of the road
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Serra de la Forada ridge, Vall de Gallinera from Margarida
Route Description: A challenging route from Margarida onto Serra de la Forada Ridge. Along ridge before dropping down to Alpatro in Vall de Gallinera. Along valley to Benisilli then climb past castle back onto Forada Ridge, before steep descent back to start. Spectacular views throughout.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A tranquil walk through some beautiful countryside with extensive picturesque views and a visit to an interesting cave .
Directions: CV715 Bolulla to tarbena road , Just to N of Bolulla turn L and wind up to the end of surfaced road and park on col.

Route Name: Calpe Coast combined with walk no. 62 Penon d'Ifach Summit. Optional lunch at end of walk
Route Description: We will walk initially to the visitors' centre at the start of the Penon walk. After a browse around we go back to the sea front and walk along the cost path to Fustera and return.
Directions: Restaurant La Lonja, Calpe Port – near to fish market.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Penon d'Ifach summit Combined with walk no. 61 Calpe Coast. Optional Lunch at end of walk
Route Description: We join the easy walk to the visitors centre then ascend the Penon to enjoy fabulous views.
Directions: Restaurant La Lonja, Calpe Port – near to fish market.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Although a VS because of length and ascent, with the exception of a toughish ascent within the first hour, this is a moderate walk, mainly on good tracks/forestry roads.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)

Route Name: Ѧ Alcala de la Jovada via Forada Ridge Ѧ
Route Description: Route mainly over quiet roads, tracks and paths (two mozarabic) with an ascent “off piste” back from Alcala to ridge. Wonderful views of the Vall de Galinera.
Directions: Park behind Co-op in Benissiva (on right just as you enter the village) CV700 km 53.5 Pego to Planes road.

Route Description: Lovely walk with two steady ascents which provide impressive views towards Sierra Bernia, Olta and the surrounding countryside. All on good tracks and paths with two Ermitas thrown in for good measure.
Directions: Lleus Plaza Lat 38.679402, Long: 0.013518 From Benissa follow signs to Pinos. After 1km take left towards Lleus, then in 2 kms take right into Cami de Lleus. At the next road fork take right and carry on until the Lleus Ermita where you park.

Route Name: Ѧ Carrasca Ridge de Val d’Ebo Ѧ
Route Description: A mixture of tracks, paths, and road for first 5 km to get to far end of the mountain, a tough long ascent to the ridge over rough (but not scratchy) terrain and back along the ridge. The views from the ridge are well worth the effort.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)

Route Name: Ѧ Carrasca Ridge via Barranco del Infierno Ѧ
Route Description: Route takes us down the barranco which is rocky underfoot, up a marked path for half the ascent with the remainder over rough (but not scratchy) terrain onto the ridge and back down marked paths and tracks.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Interesting track to barranco bottom. Tough scree ascent to Cavall summit. Splendid views. Some boulder-hopping. Good paths for return to Sagra.
Directions: From Orba turn right at Pego/Rafol junction in Sagra, drive through village and park on rough ground or street on left at edge of village.

Route Name: Barranc de Sequer, Col de Garga and Dos Fuentes circuit
Route Description: A varied walk up a dramatic remote Barranco partially along a ridge. Return passing 2 fonts. Extensive scenic views.
Directions: Take the CV 720 from Benichembla towards Castells. Turn right just past Villa Mercedes sign posted Val d'Ebo. Continue until you reach a layby on the left shortly after a Y/W finger post on the left and park here.

Route Name: Ѧ Miserat Summit (optional) Ѧ via Castell Gallinera
Route Description: A toughish walk with a mixture of marked roads, tracks and footpaths (with the exception of the optional summit which is over open but not scratchy ground). Fabulous views from the summit.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Name: Ѧ Miserat Summit & part Solana del Garrofer Ridge Ѧ
Route Description: A tough walk much over virgin terrain. There is a little easy scrambling in parts, some scratchy bits (but not much) and some boulder hopping but nothing that should deter a regular mountain walker. The rewards are the stunning views. Bring your camera so you can show your kids/grand-kids and bore your friends!
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Segaria summit from the East Ѧ
Route Description: A very pleasant walk for the main part around this rugged mountain with a tough ascent over some rocky ground to the summit.
Directions: Take CV729 to Benimeli and park where possible. If congested turn off the CV729 at brown sign "Pou de Baix" where more places should be available and go to the church square where the walk begins

Route Description: A walk out to the West side of Vall D'Ebo which starts and ends on country roads but is then mainly on rough animal tracks which can be a little scratchy in places. Initially following the Rio Ebo the walk makes its way around and onto the Serra Sireret taking in some unspoilt valleys and ridges with spectacular 360⁰ views. Although the walk is rough underfoot in places and has a couple of strenuous climbs it is worth the effort.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A circuit initially on quiet rural tarmac roads which give fantastic views of the mountains to the south, followed by a footpath descending beside the Barranc del Hort a 100m section of rough stuff and then tracks all the way back to Bolulla.
Directions: On the CV715 that runs on the outskirts of the village, at the southern end of the village turn downhill to the E beside a children's' play area to find ample parking along a wide road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Los Tres Pueblos de la Vall de Laguar
Route Description: A very pleasant walk and an excellent appetiser for lunch taken on the walk. Some stunning scenery.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel; park in the large public car park on right opposite Bar Restaurante Jalisco.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A varied route, taking in Calpe's salt lake, parts of the promenades, Calpe woods and also includes some (hopefully dry) riverbed walking. Round the lake and in the riverbeds is uneven underfoot so please wear strong shoes or boots.
Directions: Aldi Supermarket Car Park Calle Suecia, 03710 Calpe, Alicante, Spain

Route Description: An interesting circuit all on well marked paths and tracks with a small amount on quiet roads. Lovely views
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Description: A testing walk partly over well established paths and tracks, some over less well established paths and animal tracks and about 2km “off-piste” over rocky terrain. Wonderful views from start to finish over sections of Sierras Caballo Verde and Carrasca. Can be shortened if conditions require it.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel. Large car park (The only one in the village) on right opposite Bar / Restaurante Jalisco
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barranc de Sequer circuit from Petracos
Route Description: A dramatic walk up through a remote barranco with 3 or 4 tricky but small scrambles with one requiring an awkward walk across a sloping slab and then followed by an easier return on generally good paths with wide ranging views.
Directions: Take the CV720 as it runs into the interior through Alcalali and Benchembla and at a junction beside Villa Mercedes turn R (signed Vall d'Ebo and Petracos). Continue up this road to find a large layby on the LHS which will accommodate up to 20 vehicles (shortly after one which might accommodate 4/5) Park here.

Route Name: Ѧ Les Fois to Cim del Penyalba Circuit Ѧ
Route Description: After Car sharing to the start at Les Foies. Delightful scenery leads to a fine open ridge, to visit a Forat, then follows an exposed scrambling section (optional). Crossing subsidiary tops with some mildly exposed steps. Very easy unavoidable scrambling to the summit with wonderful views. Almost entirely on paths, many are rugged and in places steep and rocky.
Directions: From Gandia on CV-675 at roundabout on edge of Barx. Take first exit onto C' Pep Andres Garba and turn immediately right and right again. Pass the Ajuntament De Barx Office, then turn right into car park.

Route Description: At the lower end of the M/S grade, this new circular route combines tracks on the lower part of Olta to arrive at the Lleus Ermita and from there tracks in the little walked Tossal de la Rapita and Ferrandet areas . Good views and varied tracks in a new area.
Directions: After km172 from Calpe on the LHS and after km 173 from Benissa on RHS take the permitted turn and within a few metres park on the rough ground on the LHS

Route Description: A very pleasant walk around this rugged mountain with an option to take in the lowest of the three peaks.
Directions: Take CV729 to Benimeli. In centre of Benimeli turn off CV729 at brown sign “Pou de Baix”. Park near outdoor piscina.

Route Description: Small amount on roads, but mainly on marked paths. Lovely walk with splendid views.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Name: Castle L' Ocaive , L'Era de Raboses , Font Coberta circuit
Route Description: Begin along a path beside an old water pipe (asequia ),enjoy some all round views from mostly well marked and preserved paths and tracks ,an optional visit up to the restored castle , a large era and several fonts ' en route ' and a downhill return
Directions: Ermita Sant Blas

Route Description: The classic mozarabic trail route with three steep descents and ascents to the Rio Ebo, Barranco del Infierno and Barranco de Racons. All on good tracks.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel. Large car park (The only one on the village) on right opposite Bar / Restaurante Jalisco
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Description: A delightful excursion on the flanks of Monduver visiting several corrales with views towards the craggy summit and back over the coas
Directions: From exit 60 on the AP7 follow the road back under the motorway and continue ahead to a roundabout where you turn R. Turn R again to enter the town and continue directly ahead over roundabouts to meet a staggered junction where you continue ahead into Carrer Doctor Maranon. At the end of this turn L into Carrer Hortes and then L again into Carrer Monduver. Park in the marked bays.

Route Name: Cavall Bernat via Creu del Cadenal
Route Description: Ascend through steep woodland to the open ridge at ‘Pas de Sant Sofi’. Scramble up to the Crue del Cardinal (optional). Regain the col and scramble up the imposing looking peak of Cavall Bernat on an improbable and complex route via a hidden cannal (gully). Descent is by straightforward paths. Steep and rough in places, but no real exposure. Wonderful views of mountains and the Valencian plains.
Directions: Leave AP7 at June 59 to Favara. At roundabout turn R on N332. In centre of Favara turn R on CV-510. Go st on to Llauri. Enter town, turn L , then 2nd R, turn 2nd L to Poble Nue. Park on roadside at playground.

Route Description: A short Moderate walk that is only just in this category, almost all good tracks. Uphill to the fort for packed lunch and downhill return. Fabulous views
Directions: On road between Pinos and Xalo/Jalon at km 11.6 take spur to south. Park near Bernia Inn.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A chance to explore much of the Gallinera valley bottom visiting both sides of the valley flanks.
Directions: Follow the CV700 W from Pego to the KM45 marker (on LHS). Turn R (signed Parquing!) here down a small lane and curve around to the R at the bottom to find a large new village car park (signed)."
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: A moderate walk on mostly good paths along quiet country lanes to Murla, and returning to Parcent.
Directions: On Cooperativa, Av. de la Constitució, 3, 03792 Parcent, Alicante
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times
Lunch_break notes: Optional lunch at the Cooperativa Restaurant in Parcent.

Route Description: A very scenic walk from the village down and then along the river path towards Guadalest. The return follows forest tracks back to the village. Some paths B grade. Splendid countryside with some spectacular views.
Directions: Car Park at Xirles, JVM7+8FX Xirles, Spain. About 1km from Polop."
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Mix of track, road and pleasant footpaths leading across to the summit cross of Senija passing by a zoo on the return!
Directions: Square next to church. Lliber village is in Jalon Valley on CV 750 between Senija and Jalon
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Dos Fuentes from Col de Garga
Route Description: A pleasant walk in some stunning scenery
Directions: On entering village take first right and follow road around edge of village, past bar Les Rogetes (old bar Oasis), left at refuse bins then right. Proceed out of village to the Col and park near the Bar/Restaurante.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Alcalà de la Jovada via Forada ridge - the easier route
Route Description: Two different mozarabic paths to and from the ridge - very impressive. Route over quiet roads, tracks and paths. You visit an impressive nevera (ice house), a cave house on the ridge and the Forat (stone arch). Wonderful views of the Vall de Gallinera.
Directions: Park behind Co-op in Benissiva (on right just as you enter the village) CV700 km 53.5 Pego to Planes road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Miserat Ѧ summit (optional) via Castell Gallinera - shortened route.
Route Description: A toughish walk with a mixture of marked roads, tracks and paths. Fabulous views from the summit and down the Barranco de la Canal. One ascent (which is not optional) is steep, not a scramble, but steep, so the use of your hands on occasions will prove helpful
Directions: Meet at Xiringuito La Verdala in the Passage Atzaneto where there is ample parking. (The Xiringuito is available for refreshments for early arrivals and at the completion of the walk.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Tossal Grau (Albert's Peak) returning over Solana del Garrofer and the Rio Ebo
Route Description: An interesting walk that starts with a lovely mozarabic ascent out of the valley. Splendid views from the summit of Tossal Grau and the Solana del Garrofer ridge.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Creu del Cardenal & Monestir de La Murta
Route Description: Part of ‘Ruta Botanica’ leads over a col, then to the summit of ‘Creu del Cardenal’. Descend through the historic site of ‘Monestir de Santa Maria de La Murta’ via an aqueduct, ermitas & a Nevada. Natural woodland, good scenery & wide ranging views. Though relatively short this rugged route is rewarding. Some steep sections with scramble’y rock steps, up & down, though not difficult or exposed.
Directions: Leave AP-7 at junction 59. Turn R onto N332. In centre of Favara turn R onto CV-510. Go straight on for 11km to roundabout just before Alzira. Turn L onto Cami, signed to ‘Monestir de la Murta’ continue directly to car park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: This is a lovely walk with two very short but steep climbs that will be taken slowly but the reward is magnificent 360 deg views.
Directions: Please note, when arriving at the new Benissa North roundabout that your sat nav (if used) may misdirect. Continue on to roundabout to find the turn marked cemetary/cemeterio and meet there. There will be a very short drive to the start of the walk.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Lliber to Senja via the hidden valley
Route Description: A circular walk on good track/paths from Lliber to Senja via the hidden valley then back to Lliber.
Directions: Meet in public car park behind the medical centre / rastro car park off Carrer Colom which is off Carrer Sant Francesco

Route Description: Mostly paths & tracks, through attractive countryside, via several locations of antiquarian interest. With short steep ascents to the Molins & up slopes below Coll de Pous. The descent from the Molins via new paths is steep, with awkward steps down bancals, over rough & sometimes scratchy terrain. Good level of agility required!
Directions: From CV738 at edge of village, turn into C' Pare Pere opposite buildings of Sabadell Solbank. Continue into C' Major, turn 1st L into C' Atmetllers, L at junction into C' Pinaret. Park on road or gravel car park on R.

Route Description: A circuit of Forada ridge from Benissiva on good tracks with an optional walk up to see the Forat (extra 70mtrs) or an extended banana break for those wanting to recover. Fantastic views down the Gallinera valley.
Directions: Park behind Co-op in Benissiva (on right just as you enter the village) CV700 km 53.5 Pego to Planes road.

Route Description: Marked paths throughout. The route is initially through the lanes and orange groves of Pego to the Font del Baladrar and then on further lanes before reaching tracks and paths which climb, a little steeply in parts to the Castell d'Ambra with magnificent views overlooking Pego and the surrounding countryside.
Directions: From El Vergel/N332 take the CV700 to Pego. Turn L at the second traffic island (beside the Cooperativa) and park towards the end of the wide road before the cross roads.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Set off on an old Eric Wright route then continue on to a mixture of interesting barranco and valley paths with some excellent rock features then return down an old Y/W to the village. Includes a very steep ascent out of riverbed ( not scrambling but tough ) !!
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)

Route Name: Mirador Coll de Rates from Alcalalí, via Mosqueres, Camí de la Pansa, Camí de Tárbena & Mestre
Route Description: From Alcalalí on the PR-CV-425, initally on rural tracks through the campo, then climbing the steep and narrow path to Coll de Rates. Returning via the steep and narrow Camí de la Pansa and paths of Parcent.
Directions: From Alcalalí, take the CV-720 towards Parcent. About 300m outside the village (approx km 40.3), take the turning on the left signposted "Ecopark", which takes you into Carrer de Ravalet.  There is a parking area directly ahead of you, above the Ecopark; park and meet here.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Lliber, Tossal Pla and Muntanyet circuit
Route Description: An interesting route on mozarabic paths, low rise ridges with extensive views, hunters trails, a tranquil barranco, vine fields and numerous ruins and wells en route.
Directions: Meet in public car park behind the medical centre / rastro car park off Carrer Colom which is off Carrer Sant Francesco
Restrictions: Wednesdays only; avoid weekends / fiestas due to possibilitiy of hunters

Route Description: Starting in Bollula Village, all on good tracks. Takes in part of the Somo Circuit
Directions: On entering Bollula on the CV-715, from Parcent turn left or Callosa turn right and cross Rui de Bollula

Route Name: Senija Lliber circuit via la Creu, Camí dels Morterets, Muntanyet & Camí de Pedra i Aigua
Route Description: From Senija to Llíber via Tossal de la Creu, Camí dels Morterets and Muntanyet, and returning through the vineyards on the Camí de Pedra i Aigua.
Directions: Park on Avinguda de les Corts Valenciana and meet at the recreational area on the right at the far end, on corner with Carrer Santissim Crist.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: The start is an easy walk through the woods by Los Lagos. This is followed by a steep climb 380 meter up the gully, the last part over the gully is exposed. Once at the top the walk is moderate as we head along the western end of the Montgo with view over Denia and Jesus Pobre, then the descent to Los Lagos. Rough under foot at times.
Directions: Los Lagos. km 6 on CV735 between La Xara (near Denia) and Javea. Turn into Los Lagos, then immediately left and park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A moderate ascent, then easy walking to the remains of an Iberian settlement with views over Denia and Jesus Pobre. Rough under foot at times
Directions: Los Lagos. km 6 on CV735 between La Xara (near Denia) and Javea. Turn into Los Lagos, then immediately left and park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: This route starts at Calpe Tennis Club and takes us up to the Ermita de San Juan. From there it then follows part of the Pedros Paseo route to the Quisi watermill before returning to Calpe via a new route. Varied tracks and great views to both the coast and the mountains.
Directions: Calpe tennis club (coming into Calpe from the N332, turn left at the Mas y Mas Centro Comercial roundabout and park by the tennis club or opposite).

Route Name: Circuit to Cova Blanca clockwise (shorter route)
Route Description: An interesting walk on marked tracks and paths Lovely views.
Directions: Meet at Xiringuito La Verdala in the Passage Atzaneto where there is ample parking. (The Xiringuito is available for refreshments for early arrivals and at the completion of the walk.)

Route Description: From Fleix head thro the tunnel to Isbert's Dam then along the valley floor before climbing to Fontilles. After which we climb thro pleasant woodland and good paths past Font De Gel and continue upwards before swinging round to walk back down to Fleix.
Directions: Park opposite the school in the new car park in Fleix on the CV718.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Name: Forna circuit to Font d'en Carros
Route Description: A chance to walk over this heavily wooded ridge line with plenty of shade for the warmer months. More ascent is necessary during the second part of the day. Great views of Azafor and north towards Montduver.
Directions: Car park on LHS at entrance to village.

Route Name: Penon d'Ifach summit Combined with walk no. 61 Calpe Coast. Optional Lunch at end of walk
Route Description: We join the easy walk to the visitors centre then ascend the Penon to enjoy fabulous views.
Directions: Restaurant La Lonja, Calpe Port – near to fish market.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: From Fleix down thro' tunnel to Isbert's Dam. Climb steep 'shelf' to left of road and continue upwards for an hour. Swing round to Mozarabic Path leading eventually to Benimaurell, but leaving this path to descend the 'corkscrew' (If conditions allow). Then rejoin the path & onwards to Benimaurell. From there it is back to Fleix by way of the old road.
Directions: Park opposite the school in the new car park in Fleix on the CV718.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Description: Route takes us upwards towards the Forada ridge under the Forat and on to visit five of the eight villages in the beautiful Vall de Gallinera.
Directions: Follow the CV700 from Pego, through Adsubia and reach the car park (with bins) at the outskirts of the village.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Beniali to Forat and back via Alt de Xap
Route Description: From Beniali we walk towards Benisiva and from here up to the Forada ridge, we walk along the top of the Forada ridge to the cave house. Over the Alt de Xap and then down the mozarabic trail to Benirama and then back to Beniali.
Directions: Take CV700 from Pego, direction Planes and turn left to village at km 46.5. Turn right as you enter the village to parking area.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Mainly good tracks with some rough patches. Up the mozarabic trail at the back of Benirama up to the Forada ridge and then some road work to a dew pool. Onwards then to Val d'EbBo via the Ebo gorge, through the village and some more road work up towards the col de Miserat. Great views towards the coast and then back down the mozarabic trail to Benirama.
Directions: Take CV700 from Pego, direction Planes and turn left to village at km 46.5. Turn right as you enter the village to parking area.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Montgo Javea Summit from Denia Ѧ
Route Description: An “up and down” walk with a steady climb to the summit of Montgo. 360 degree views from the top. Slight scramble from the top – helps to have long legs! Also helps to be sure footed with a head for heights.  This will be taken at a slower pace than normal for a VS graded walk.
Directions: At the entrance to the Parque Natural above the Ermita Pare Pere on Calle Fenas in Denia.

Route Name: Col de Miserat from Vall d'Ebo – extended
Route Description: Up to the start of the mozarabic trail to Benirrama and then back via a pretty gorge to Val d’Ebo (excl.Barranco del Infierno). Lovely views.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Juvees del Poble d'Enwig circuit returning via barranco del infierno
Route Description: Christened the “easy out hard back” by some wag it starts with a lovely mozarabic path ascent, then a simple strolly with lovely views, down to the barranco (part of the 5000 steps) and back via the barranco. A very interesting return.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Miserat summit from Benirrama with interesting "off-piste" final ascent
Route Description: The walk is on well defined paths, tracks and a small amount on quiet country roads. The views from the summit are STUNNING and the final stretch back to Benirrama is via an excellent Mozarabic track
Directions: Follow the CV700 from Pego up the Gallinara valley past Adsubia. Reach a turning on the L (CV170) to Benirrama which you take to the village. Bear R/ahead on the village street to a more open area where you park.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barranco de la Cova to Col de Miserat circuit
Route Description: Small amount on quiet country roads but mainly on marked paths.
Directions: Meet at Xiringuito La Verdala in the Passage Atzaneto where there is ample parking. (The Xiringuito is available for refreshments for early arrivals and at the completion of the walk.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A gentle stroll along the seafront in Denia leading up to Torre de Gerro and back. Walk is all on paved surfaces and is on the easy side of moderate.
Directions: Meeting at the car park at the entrance to Denia Marina, as you leave Denia heading for Javea. Turn at the roundabout at the entrance to the Marina and the car park is on the left.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Castell d'Aixa circuit from Llosa de Comacho – a shorter route
Route Description: A route to the summit on quiet country roads, tracks and mainly marked paths. Some sections are quite steep and occasionally exposed. Not a scramble as such but the use of hands on occasions will be helpful. The views at the Castell (summit) are stunning and well worth the effort.
Directions: Park in spaces at the top of the village.

Route Description: A demanding mountain challenge with fantastic scenic views into Barranco Tancat,up to Bolulla castle on its rocky promontory and across to the summit of Aixorta with views to the coast on return.
Directions: CV715 Callosa to Tarbena road,at outskirt of Bolulla turn up Calle Projector Dos near bins and park in street.

Route Name: Barranco Cau and Lloma Larga Ridge
Route Description: Walk up the barranco Cau and into the Marnes valley. We then get some of the ascent up Lloma Larga over before we have lunch near the top with spectacular views. Back along the ridge with great views back to the coast.
Directions: Km8 on the CV750, Benissa to Jalon road, opposite Restaurant Venta Roja, next to rubbish bins..

Route Description: A picturesque walk taking in several pretty valleys and Neveras. The walk/scramble up and through Fat Mans Agony can be tough. After a there and back visit to the summit we will continue along the east ridge to return to the cars via more pretty valleys. This is the highest mountain range in the Costa Blanca so a tough but rewarding walk.
Directions: Take the CV70 from La Nucia. Pass the KM 34 sign, 0.7km further on take the L road (sign for El Trestellador). Follow this, ignore the left turn, for 1.2km to group of houses and a concrete area on the left which is Font Moli

Route Name: La Solana, Tossal Gran and Riu Xalo o de Gorgos
Route Description: Head directly away from Jalon across terraces and steep track to caves above Alcalali, then east across the ridge after a steep scramble. Descend before the Castle D'Axia ridge, coming back round to ascend under the meridian point up to Tossal Gran with another steep scramble. Descend again along well used mozarabic, turning off to a new path back to the north side of Lliber and then onto Jalon.
Directions: Park and meet by the Tourist Information Centre in Xaló / Jalón, opposite Casa Aleluya.
Restrictions: Not Saturdays; parking is impossible due to the rastro.

Route Description: Easy walk round Olta track defined path up from Lleus excellent views
Directions: Lleus Plaza. From roundabout on N332 just north of Calpe near Km 170 Take Exit towards Lleus. As soon as you leave roundabout turn right along narrow lane towards Lleus. Ignore junctions to left and right. Pass under railway bridge. Follow signs to Lleus and park next to chapel (3.3km from N332 - 8 minutes)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A pleasant circuit on a country road, marked paths and some rough tracks, steep in places but with no exposure. Beautiful views of country and coast and passes a Refugio where if necessary water can be replenished.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)

Route Description: We stroll though Sierra Helada National Park to the lighthouse and return, optional climb down to Ochre Mines.
Directions: Lighthouse Car Park. Note different start time. From N332 Mc Donald's follow main road to sea front, Albir; turn R,before beach sign, up narrow road to car park.

Route Description: Lleus to Tossel de Pinos via Barranc with waterfall scramble
Directions: From roundabout on N332 just north of Calpe near Km 170 Take Exit towards Lleus. As soon as you leave roundabout turn right along narrow lane towards Lleus. Ignore junctions to left and right. Pass under railway bridge. Follow signs to Lleus and park next to chapel (3.3km from N332 - 8 minutes)

Route Description: A very pleasant walk and an excellent appetiser before lunch. Although this is an easy walk as defined by taking less than 4.5 hours and with a total ascent not exceeding 200m the final section of the walk is, however, steep which will need to be taken at a slow pace with ample stops to rest. Some stunning scenery.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel. Large car park (The only one in the village) on right opposite Bar / Restaurante Jalisco

Route Description: Circular route. Some vegetation. Great coast and country views.
Directions: From N332 Calpe to Benissa road take turn to CV750 Jalon ,near Km10 park on lay by st LHS near info board for Benissa municipal Restaurant , Piscina,Tennis

Route Description: Circular route. Some vegetation. Great coast and country views.
Directions: Km8 on the CV750, Benissa to Jalon road, opposite Restaurant Venta Roja, next to rubbish bins.

Route Name: Ruta Circular Sierra de Olta from Calpe
Route Description: A prolonged  intial ascent via Calpe station takes us up to the Zona d'Acampada d'Olta. From here we will do the classic Olta Circular (PR-CV 340) via Pas de la Canal, with stunning views to the interior and coast, to the Ermita de Sant Francesc, and then descend to Calpe on zigzag paths through the trees.
Directions: Park and meet by Casa Miguel bar in Calle San Fermin, Calpe.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Olta summit and circuit Ѧ
Route Description: The start of the walk in nearby the Hospital of Calpe. It's a circulair walk around the Olta. There're different routes to visit Cim Olta and La Mola
Directions: From N332 take the direction to Calp-sur. First roundabout keep right and next corner in front of hospital go right into the Calle San Fermin. Parking on the street nearby restaurant Toix
Restrictions: Saturdays Only

Route Description: Varied walk almost all on forestry tracks with short riverbed stretch and one mozarabic path.
Directions: Aitana Commercial Centre car park, from the N332 follow yurn off sign to Calpe station and almost immediately take a left turn to the Aitana Commercial Centre car park and park at the far end
Restrictions: Wednesdays only

Route Description: A circular walk with wonderful views and passing the Cova's Negra and Blannca en route. All on marked paths, but with steep ascent and rough underfoot in places.
Directions: Meet at Xiringuito La Verdala in the Passage Atzaneto where there is ample parking. (The Xiringuito is available for refreshments for early arrivals and at the completion of the walk.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: Steady climbing over Tossal del Moro then more of the same to reach the summit of Serrellars. pleasant paths lead back, across the southern flanks. Wonderful views.
Directions: Benissa motorway tunnels. From Benissa take the access road to the motorway and then look for the small turnoff on the right signed to the Cementerio. Do not turn off to the cemetery but continue on this track for 2,2km parallel to the motorway until reach the tunnel and park there, Be aware your GPS might try and take you onto the motorway!

Route Description: A scenic route on both flanks of the valley with a stiff early ascent and good quiet tracks and paths after this.
Directions: Car Park on CV700 at E end of village

Route Name: Cap Negret , llano del Castillo Stroll
Route Description: A circular stroll along the riverside inland past a tranquil pond to Tossal de L’Algepsa and return through country lanes to Altea via the edge or the town back to the cars.
Directions: Meet at parking area on Partida Les Quintanes, just along from Junction Via Pista/Partida Les Quintanes and Cami de L’ Algar, adjacent to river bed
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Passet del Golero via Carrascal Ridge, Barrancs Del Arc & Xarquer
Route Description: Via the valley of Barranc del Arc. Then steeply up & over the ridge of El Carrascal, descending past the Buddhist Colony, before reascending via a mozarabic path over Passet del Golero. Down past the cliffs of Barranc del Xarquer. Superb scenery & interesting terrain. Mostly straightforward tracks & paths, though some are unmarked complicated, steep & rugged. Parts overgrown but not scratchy.
Directions: CV-770 km 15.3 At eastern end, enter side road passing car parks, turn R & keep R passing beneath Cemetery. Follow road into Barranc del Arc for 4km. When tarmac ends turn R past Refugio Font de l'Arc. Park on R.
Restrictions: Car parking at the Refugio can be limited at weekends, when many rock climbers visit the area! The ascent to the ruins via the drainage shoot could be very slippery when wet! The gpx. track is for the shorter route which is fully described.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Cocoll Summit via Barranco d’Almadic Ѧ
Route Description: A picturesque route to the summit (1048m) with breathtaking views over the barranco.del Gallistero to the Serrella and Alfaro ridges.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, Benichembla on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells

Route Description: A mixture of good paths. Good ridge walking with two shaley descents. Splendid views if a clear day on region’s highest peak.
Directions: Follow the CV70 from Benidorm / Polop direction towards Guadalest / Alcoy ,after Benimantell near to Km28 turn L (signed Benifato ) soon after turn up 2nd RH street ( sign for Fuente Partagat on wall ) continue up this steep minor road to arrive at the Fuente /Font
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Circular walk on good paths with views to Aitana, Puig Campana and the sea. Lunch near to El Cantal , a popular rock climbing location
Directions: Meet at Ex-Restaurante “Venta el Charco” near km post 132 on N332, South of Villajoyosa and its bypass. We will drive up rough forest tracks to the start. Lifts can be arranged for those in posh cars.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Puig Taster, Circular Stroll in Foothills of Puig
Route Description: Scenic walk with good views of Puig and back to the coast.
Directions: La Nucia Elian’s School,Avinguda el Copet 5. Directions to start: A7 Jct 65, N332, at roundabout CV70 direction La Nucia.Go straight on for 3 roundabouts. 4th roundabout 3rd exit, next roundabout, take the 1st exit. at next roundabout school in front of you.Take 2nd turn off the roundabout. walk starts here
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Circular walk around the Embalse.
Directions: From Guadalest take CV70 through Benimantell and turn right at next junction to Beniadá. Park in car park on left after passing restaurant La Mezquita.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Short stretch of interesting river bed boulder hopping and gulleys, a dam to cross and a bamboo challenge, then well defined trails up Font de la Mata and back to Gata. A river bypass is available for anyone with dodgy legs.
Directions: From traffic lights where Xabía road meets N332 drive 200m North and take left turn (Calle Trossets). After 100m, opposite Restaurante Trossets, Turn right & park in car park. Cafe nearby for early birds
Restrictions: Wednesdays only to allow for optional menu del dia
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Santa Maira, Serra de l ' Alfaro, La Espelda
Route Description: A varied walk with extensive views of surrounding mountains from a low level ridge , opportunity for sightings of various wildlife . Early easy scrambling on rough terrain then onto forest track and paths .
Directions: CV720 from Benichembla direction just before entering Castells village turn sharp R ,downhill and continue to park near sheep pens / basura area

Route Description: Mostly good paths. The semi-scramble to the castle is optional for those without a head for heights.
Directions: Follow the CV70 from Benidorm / Polop direction towards Guadalest / Alcoy ,after Benimantell near to Km28 turn L (signed Benifato ) soon after turn up 2nd RH street ( sign for Fuente Partagat on wall ) continue up this steep minor road to arrive at the Fuente /Font
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A circular route through some delightful countryside with extensive views of surrounding mountains and down to the coast ,includes a short , easy scramble and several historic features ' en route '..
Directions: Follow CV750 Alcalali to Murla road , in Murla turn R to cemetery car park ( signed P )

Route Name: Ѧ Miserat summit (optional) Ѧ the shortened route in reverse
Route Description: Tremendous walk all on marked tracks and paths and a short distance on quiet roads. We visit a cave at the source of the Barranco de la Canal which is well worth the effort. Lovely views throughout especially from the Miserat summit.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Name: Ѧ Montduver figure of eight Ѧ
Route Description: A route up to the summit of this attractive mountain and then back above some imposing crags to return to the valley.
Directions: At km 231.2 on the N332 going N look for a Patri supermarket on the RHS. Take the next turning L into a campo road and follow this over the motorway and up into the valley until just before the tarmac ends where there is parking in front of a ruin on the LHS.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A very pleasant walk and an excellent appetiser before lunch (taken on the walk) . Some stunning scenery. Although this is an easy walk as defined by being less than 4.5 hours and with a total ascent not exceeding 200m there is, however, a steep middle section.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel. Large car park (The only one in the village) on right opposite Bar / Restaurante Jalisco

Route Description: A clockwise route up Montgo taking in Denia Cross (summit ) along rocky ridge to Javea summit and return down barranco below Penya de l' Aguila .Relentless rocky paths rewarded by extensive views throughout.
Directions: CV735 from Javea direction , 20 MTRS.before turn to Jesus Pobre is minor road at RHS ,take this and drive up to park near disused sub- station .

Route Name: Rio Serpis Circuit with optional easy route back
Route Description: After a scenic walk alongside the Rio Serpis for 5km along the old railway line passing through some dark tunnels (bring torch) we will have a banana break at the old hydro plant. We return the same way but those on the harder option will make a steep climb up the side of the valley before descending down Cami Real to the cars
Directions: Bar la Cuineta, Carr de Ador 19, Villalonga. After sorting lunch choices we will drive to start of walk 38.875321,-0.243352.
Restrictions: Wednesdays only
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Sanchet circular with wonderful views over Els Castellets. Well-defined paths throughout. Breakaway groups can go over the summit if you know the way.
Directions: CV70 between La Nucia and Guadalest. Park in Rincon de Pepe’s car park and be sure to have a drink there afterwards to reward him.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: L ' Abdet to Pla de la Casa figure of eight
Route Description: An extended figure of eight with a bit of everything - a barranco , a summit , a ridge , forest paths , spectacular ( especially when almond blossom out ) scenery and views.
Directions: From CV70 Guadalest to Confrides road turn R onto CV7560 signed L' Abdet and drive to far end of village and park on public car park.

Route Description: Bus (have change for the fare) to Benidorm, then a spectacular cliff-top walk. A drink on the seafront awaits us at the end of the walk.
Directions: Park in car park behind “Consum”supermarket in centre of Albir on right-hand side of road from N332 (McDonald’s crossing) and the beach. After parking cross the road in front of Consum and meet at cafe Malibu where the coffee is good. We will catch the first bus to Benidorm after 10am at the nearby bus stop

Route Name: Tossal de la Creu (El Mirabo) via Barranco Almadic
Route Description: Gentle zig zag incline, break at the col with optional climb to El Mirabo/viewpoint over Benichembla. Gentle walk down through the woods into the village.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, Benichembla on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: La Nucia, Elian’s School to Carp Pond
Route Description: Scenic varied walk, superb views, with pleasant stop at the Carp Pond for lunch.
Directions: Meet at Elian’s School, Avinguda el Copet, 5, 03530 La Nucia. Take A7 and leave at Junction 65 onto N332, at the roundabout take the CV70 towards La Nucia. On CV70 go straight on at the next 3 roundabouts. At the fourth roundabout take the third turning onto Avinguda de Columba follow this road to the next roundabout and take the first turning off this roundabout onto Via Pista. At the next roundabout the school is in front of you.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A lovely easy walk through some existing lanes and newly re-established paths on either side of the valley.
Directions: NEW CAR PARK. Follow the CV700 W from Pego and through Adsubia until you reach the KM45 marker (on LHS). Turn R (signed Parquing!) here down a small lane and curve around to the R at the bottom to find a large new village car park (signed).

Route Description: A pleasant walk with splended views of the Gallinera valley, we visit a nevara (ice house) a desserted village and a section of the walk is on two different mozarabic trails
Directions: Park at edge of village near swimming pool. From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d'Ebo. Continue past Vall d'Ebo to Alcala de la Jovada.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Javea La Plana from the Port
Route Description: From Javea Port we go up to the lighthouse then along La Plana to the windmills and back down to the Port. A delightful coastal walk with some fine views.
Directions: Meet at the fishing boat on Avenida del Port, at the north end of Avenida d'Ausias March, where there is ample on-street parking.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A horseshoe route initially on the Carrasca ridge flank W of the Ebo gorge across some rough terrain followed by a descent to cross the gorge and then easier but longer return on the E bank of the river.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A clockwise circuit through delightful countryside, up the Azagador de Seldetes ridge onto the upper plateau & then to the summit. Descend via a spur to Corral de Burrell & return via farm tracks & paths. Virtually all the route is on paths & tracks, with wide ranging views.
Directions: N332 km 188.5 eastern end. Turn into C' Lepanto in front of "Muebles Montfort" keep L to cross bridge continue over cross roads to 'T' junction. Turn L onto C" Alcolaes. Park on gravel car park on R opposite school.

Route Description: An alternative route for the CB Way and a good leg stretcher with a car shuffle before lunch in little visited terrain. Good views and forested hills.
Directions: Follow CV700 from Pego to Adsubia. 1Km beyond Adsubia take the CV 717 towards Forna and follow this to the car park on the ourskirts of Forna.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Complete Serra de Seldetes Circuit (Tossal Aspre option)
Route Description: A long undulating traverse to gain the most easterly ridge on the northern flank, which leads via some scrambling & sections with exposure, to the summit ridge of Seldetes. All its tops are traversed & return is via the Azagador ridge. The scrambling ridge & summit traverse over karst limestone are mostly pathless with very rugged rocky terrain. Views are excellent & wide ranging.
Directions: N332 km188.5 (Benissa end). Turn into C'Lepanto in front of "Muebles Monfort" keep L to cross bridge, continue to 'T' junction. Turn L onto C' Alcolaes. Park on gravel car park on R, opposite a school.

Route Description: The walk starts with a vaguely marked ascent to Punta d'Alfaro followed by a long pleasant ridge walk and short climb to the summit of Alfaro.This high spot offers wonderful views of the Sierra Serrella before descending by old tracks which lead very steeply down to Barranco Malafi. Barranco Malafi is the grandiose and remote gully formed by the, generally dry, river Malafi. Superb wild flowers in spring and early summer. Bird songs accompany the walker often nightingales and sometimes eagles can be seen.
Directions: Meeting point is near Bar Bon Airebar in Benichembla (parking place). Then drive together to the start at 38.769823,-0.195073. Take the CV/720 either going W from Benichembla or NE from Castells de Castells to Villa Mercedes at km 28. Here the side road to Val de Ebo goes N and is signposted to Petracos. Drive along this road towards Val de Ebo, for approx 3.8km. ,passing Petracos, and find some lay byes on the RHS opposite the barranco.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barranco Aspre, Font de Bernia, Pinos circuit
Route Description: A circular trail through a shallow interesting barranco in the Pinos valley and below the Bernia ridge . Spectacular late Jan/early Feb when the almond Blossom adorns the flanks of Bernia
Directions: CV749 Benissa to Pinos road, at far end of Pinos park at LHS near a shrine opposite Pinos restaurant ( please do not park in their car park )..

Route Name: Llomas de Selim and Barranco Selinas
Route Description: A barranco scramble with amazing scenery and rock formations. One or two steep descents and a dam to scramble over with the aid of a chain & iron rungs. An easier version of this route to tempt a few more into Kees Andriessen's “Red Canyon”
Directions: Bar “Venta Strambotik” On CV 800 (ex N340) from Campello to Alcoy, km 6.5 . To get there take AP7 to junction with CV 800 and then head towards Alcoy for about 3km. Bar is on right-hand side of road. (This takes only 35 minutes from Altea Junction 64 on AP7) Convoy to start of walk.

Route Description: The original route up to Nevera and summit to Font Oblits for lunch. Return past waterfall. Due to path closures the walk has been shortened.
Directions: La Font BENIFLÀ Vilallonga Turn right at THIRD roundabout. Past school then for 6.7 km past Reprimala and the quarry.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Eye of Montgo from Almacera resturant
Route Description: Restaurant to the eye of Montgo and return, 7km and 500 metres of height gain, 2.5 -3 hours, good appetiser before lunch. Start at 10am bring a snack for a 10 minute rest at the eye before returning.
