Directions: From the CV-736 between Javea & Denia turn onto C' del Cap de Sant Antoni. In 400m turn R onto Cami Curt, immediately beside Restaurant Amanecer (it looks like their car park). Park at the rear at the side of the road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: A circular ,varied walk in this scenic area ,some tough scrambling ,forest tracks ,paths ,and historic landmarks with extensive views .
Directions: CV720 Benichembla to Castell de Castells road at km6 turn R near Villa Mercedes( signed Petracos ) and continue for 4 km and park on laybye at RHS of road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Climb up to Refugio, down to Riu Girona, climb down barranco, return by mozarabic path.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: From the village we zigzag up the valley towards Guadalest via forest paths and open countryside. Spectacular scenery.
Directions: Car Park at Xirles, JVM7+8FX Xirles, Spain. About 1km from Polop.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Good scramble and return along forestry track and mozarabic path.
Directions: Immediately before entering the village of Castell de Castells from direction of Benichembla, turn sharp right, downhill past the old washhouse. At the bottom by the sheep pens and bin compound, turn left and park along this road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Scramble up one barranco and down another. Lunch at airstrip.
Directions: Bridge just after km 30 on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: The reverse of Jean Ryan’s walk. The Mont Blanc of the Costa Blanca - or is it the Matterhorn?
Directions: Calvario above Gaianes. Turn off the CV700 just before Planes on the road from Pego. To Beniarres, then Gaianes.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A stiff climb up to the ridge then down to Ermita, and along river. Scramble now made easier with ropes and stemples.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, Benichembla on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Mostly good paths. The semi-scramble to the castle is optional for those without a head for heights. Note no car shuttle on this variant.
Directions: Follow the CV70 from Benidorm / Polop direction towards Guadalest / Alcoy ,after Benimantell near to Km28 turn L (signed Benifato ) soon after turn up 2nd RH street ( sign for Fuente Partagat on wall ) continue up this steep minor road to arrive at the Fuente /Font
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Cocoll and Barranco de Encaina Ѧ
Route Description: A steep climb up this iconic mountain followed by a return down a barranco with some steep scrambly descents.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, Benichembla on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells Car share to start of walk.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: An interesting walk on marked tracks and paths Lovely views.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Name: Ѧ Coll de Rates and Font d'Olbis Ѧ
Route Description: A walk along the Carrascal ridge before exploring the Font and other interesting features before an uphill finish.
Directions: Drive up the CV 715 uphill around zig-zags to arrive at the col de rates with its restaurant on the RHS. Turn up the drive to this, but park before reaching the restaurant car park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Partly on a recently constructed local trail (SL-CV)
Directions: Opposite Repsol
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: New approach to this mighty ridge. Ridge is exposed and narrow in parts. This is a demanding route. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participate.
Directions: Meet at car park near the cross roads in Alcalali of the CV750 and the CV720. Car share to start of walk.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Forada Ridge circuit from Benissiva Ѧ
Route Description: A beautiful but intensive walk around the Val de Galinera, first up to the ridge to the Penya Forada. Following the ridge till the Tosal Creu, passing the Castell Benissili down to the valley / Alpatro again. Last 1,5km little up on the left side with nice views to the Forada ridge hopefully in the afternoon sun.  Mixture of good paths and also rough terrain, sure-footedness and a head for heights are helpful.
Directions: Park behind Co-op in Benissiva (on right just as you enter the village) CV700 km 53.5 Pego to Planes road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: The walk starts on good tracks. After approx 1,5kms gradual incline with a steeper section of rocky terrain, no exposure where some clambering and use of handholds is required. Relaxed pace to enjoy the beautiful scenery throughout the walk.
Directions: On CV 750 direction Jalon, at Mamut Lliber, turn left onto Camino Deposito. Follow road to meeting point at the end.
Restrictions: Car share advisable, limited parking space.

Route Name: Moli de Quisi circuit from Benissa
Route Description: From Benissa downhill on rural roads and tracks, via Ermita Santa Anna, to Molí del Quisi, and returning uphill on rural roads to Benissa.
Directions: Park and meet by Bar Frau on Avenida del Pais Valenciana in Benissa.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Mainly on mozarabic paths and forestry tracks. Good views.
Directions: After passing under the bridge in Xeraco pass Masymas supermarket on right Take the first left. This is marked no turn so turn into service road to make a u turn and cross the main road. Cross the motorway and park on the left at the end of the tarmac.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A very pretty circuit walk. North from Abdet up an old mule path which follows high above the stream to Corral Fondo and on tracks and paths by the Manecillo stream followed by a climb up an old mule path leading to the “Sculptors” casa near Raco de Llosa. Then along tracks to 900m in the valley below Pla de la Casa, (1379m).Two possibilities to cut walk short in case of fatigue or bad weather. Best avoided after very heavy or prolonged rain to avoid “boots off” stream crossings.
Directions: From Benifato drive along the CV70 towards Confrides and take the R turn signposted Abdet CV7560. After1 Km just before the village take the LH fork up and bear R at the garbage containers to use the 'by pass' to the north of the village avoiding the very narrow streets of Abdet. Drive to ample car park.

Route Description: A fine walk on mozarabic paths, forestry tracks and a ridge, not exposed, most paths well marked. Mainly straightforward, but some sections are rough and steep. The scrambling just before the summit is minimal. Low in its grade. Extensive views from many points along the route.
Directions: Turn off N332 near a BP garage (km 236) onto CV 50. Follow signs to Tavernes. At the 4th roundabout just as you enter the town, turn R onto C' Del Mestre Serrano, take the 5th road on the left into the one way system, turn 2nd right then right again onto C' Doctor Gomez Ferrer and park on the roadside.

Route Name: Ѧ Pla de la Casa & Malla de Llop Ѧ
Route Description: Two great peaks of the Serrella ridge.
Directions: Meet at Bar La Font Famorca
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barrancos de la Canal and Cova extended anti-clockwise
Route Description: A good workout in remote scenery with fantastic craggy views.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Aitana Ridge Circuit from Font Moli Ondara
Route Description: Original description too long. Must be amended to 400 characters or less. Please see WalksinSpain write up for current description.
Directions: Take the CV70 from La Nucia towards Guadalest. Pass the Km 34 sign and 0.7 km further on take the minor surfaced road going off L (sign for El Trestellador Restaurant) past a large house on the corner. Continue along this surfaced road ignoring road of left for 1.2 km. to a group of casas amidst trees and a trough, which is near the Font Moli Ondara. This is the start and there is parking for 3-4 cars with more room down road.

Route Description: Back to this favourite ridge again, good views. This is a demanding route. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participate.
Directions: Parc Natural Segaria. From N332 take El Verger turn, at old N332 turn left to a second roundabout. Turn left on CV729 towards Sagra. Turn right after 200mtrs at sign “Senders de Segaria” PR 415 to car park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Vall d'Ebo, Cova Blanca, Refugi de la Figuereta
Route Description: A pleasant circuit on a country road, marked paths and rough tracks.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Solana de la Canal to Cova Blanca
Route Description: An interesting walk with panoramic views, both steep ascents and descents, mainly on rough paths but some time on country roads. Includes Barranc and Solana de la Canal, Cova Blanca and Pintor paths.
Directions: Meet at Xiringuito La Verdala in the Passage Atzaneto where there is ample parking. (The Xiringuito is available for refreshments for early arrivals and at the completion of the walk.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Serrella & Pla de la Casa Ѧ
Route Description: Climbing up to Pla de la Casa with its nevera, along the ridge to Serrella and return by a mozarabic path.
Directions: In Facheca village on CV720 west of Castell de Castells.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A short circular route, challenging in its grade. It has a steep urban start onto the Sierra de Seguili, sweeping around the top of a barranco above the Raco de Pastor.As part of this interesting walk, we visit historic ruins and a cave. The descent has several steep sections with earthy chutes ( up to 25%)
Directions: Coming from Benidoleig, continue on CV731 for 3 km.towards Orba.Turn L signed Urbanisation L'Aspre. Continue for 450m to a marked parking area on the L. Park and meet here
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: This Easy walk with shaded forest as well as open paths and has lovely views of the surrounding mountains.
Directions: From Polop driving to Xirles as you enter the Village the car park is on the left, this is the start point. . If the car park is full carry on along the road where there are more parking spaces.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ruta dels Assegadors and Sierra Gallinera
Route Description: The descent has several steep sections with earthy chutes ( up to 25%)
Directions: Walk notice board in La Font d’En Carros. From the north end of Oliva take the La Font road, make a left turn at the second roundabout into Avinguda Exilencia Deputacio, turn left at fork, then left at crossroads, in front of Ajuntament, along C/Abdon y Senet.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Penya Covatelles, Penya dels Frares, down to Forna return via Pujada de Gualte
Directions: Meet near petrol station at north end of Oliva to drive to start of walk.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: The walk from Partagas provides superb panoramic views and passes two Neveras. It has the added interest of an exciting scramble via the Fat Man's Agony pass which opens up additional magnificent panoramic views to the South. Crossing the long undulating ridge you will be on top of the highest mountain range in Costa Blanca. Good agility, stamina and a head for heights are required.
Directions: Follow the CV70 from Benidorm / Polop direction towards Guadalest / Alcoy .After Benimantell near to Km28 turn L (signed Benifato ) soon after turn up 2nd RH street (sign for Fuente Partagat on wall ) continue up this steep minor road to come to the Partagas Fuente /Font. (Grid Ref 38.657767,-0.241871, however you are advised not to use Sat Nav or Google Maps as it will take you round in circles)

Route Name: Tossal de Pelat and Tossal de Creu
Route Description: Now the original walk, mainly on newly cleared mozarabic paths. A gentle climb around Miserat, Tossal de Creu along Solana de Garoffer above Vall d'Ebo and return on a different path.
Directions: Adsubia on Pego to Planes road turn left at the next turn after Bar Moleta. Take the second right, marked with PR signpost, to reservoir. Park near reservoir. .
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barranco Calvo, Alcala de la Jovada, Barranco Malafi circuit
Route Description: A varied walk in this popular area , an interesting barranco, forest paths and tracks , historic landmarks and spectacular views.
Directions: CV720 Benichembla to Castells road at Km6 , turn R at Villa Mercedes and continue for 4kms and park on layby at RHS of road

Route Description: An interesting route up and over Mulero, through two beautiful valleys and the ' silent Buddhist retreat ' and return via the ' passo de contadores. Spectacular views and some little visited paths.
Directions: CV70 Polop to Guadalest road, at Km. 33.5 turn L at sign for Trestelledor Hotel, soon after turn L at next small junction, after approx. 200 mtrs. park at layby.

Route Description: A long steep early ascent is rewarded by a new walk along one of the longest ridges of the Costa Blanca with extensive views of coast and mountains.
Directions: CV767 direction Finestrat- at large roundabout before Finestrat turn L on CV759 direction La Vila Joiosa, immediately before Km.5 turn R on narrow surfaced road , follow for 2.3 kms and park on open ground at LHS near electricity pylon.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Extended walk around Tossal Grau from Pollop
Route Description: Walking along small routes and stony path with fews over the surrounding mountains and the sea you circle Tossal Grau. Some short steep climbs followed by easier sections.
Directions: Coming from The road trough Polop from Callosa d'en Sarrià or from La Nucia take Passeig de la Solana and after going up Hill go left on Carrer Capri until you see a big parking above you. Turn on the parking
Dogs: Dogs by prior arrangement with leader only

Route Name: Ѧ Aixorta summit and ridge from km 7 Ѧ
Route Description: A walk around one of the highest ridge lines on the Costa Blanca with a terrific scramble if you fancy it!
Directions: Take the CV720 from Pedreguer, through Parcent and on to Castell de Castells. Here turn L onto the CV752 and proceed uphill in zig-zags. When you reach a plateau area look out for the km 7 marker and park on the track beside a notice board.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Alt del Ample and Marnes from Jalon
Route Description: A magnificent walk up to the Marnes plateau with panoramic views all around and return over the slopes of Alt del Ample.
Directions: Take the cemetery road that runs between the petrol station and the Tot Util Ferreteria. At the end go round a bend to the right and park immediately on the right.

Route Description: A pleasant circular walk around and through Parcent village.
Directions: Bar/Restaurante Piscina. From Parcent take CV715 (Rates to Tarbena road) for about 1 km. Car park on right.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Barranco Sinc from Font del L'Hortet del Pobre
Route Description: A circular route on well defined paths. A stiff climb up to the Ermeta is followed by a spectacular trail along the rim of the barranco past the Vulture lookout. A sharp descent then a return path back through the base of the barranco Sinc before a climb back to the start.
Directions: From Alcoy Railway Station drive to Consum Supermarket, Keep right into Av. Carmen Vidal. Cross bridge and take first right exit from roundabout into Carrer Barranc del Sinc (CV 796). Continue for 2.7 km. Park near Cantina.

Route Name: Alt del Xap and El Passet circuit from Benirrama
Route Description: A lovely outing with fantastic views forwards to the Forada and R across to the far side of the Gallinera valley with the unspoiled villages below you.
Directions: Take CV700 from Pego, direction Planes and turn left to village at km 46.5. Turn right as you enter the village to parking area.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties

Route Description: A circular walk, through the countryside from Calpe up to the campsite and then, following little used tracks, in an anti-clockwise direction, the route runs parallel to the traditional wide-track Olta circuit and returns via Calpe railway station.
Directions: From the N332, take the road towards the centre of Calpe. At the roundabout, just before the (Mas y Mas) Plaza Central complex, take the left turn. At the next small roundabout continue straight and 75m later you will see the Tennis Club on the LHS. Park there or on the waste ground opposite.
Reservation notes: RESERVATION REQUIRED; WhatsApp leader to reserve place.

Route Description: The walk links in with part of the well known Circuit of Puig Campana but going anti clockwise reveals different views. The valleys around Tossal del Grau are very beautiful and surprisingly unfrequented. Views are excellent. Puig Campana resembles a volcano from this direction and Ponoch hints at its massive bulk and sheer cliffs.
Directions: From La Nucia drive south along the CV70 towards Benidorm to Km.44. Immediately after the sign turn R and zero your odometer. Drive along the surfaced road with Montebello urbanization on your L and a new urbanization across the barranco on your R. for approx 0.9 km to reach a roundabout. Go straight across this roundabout and continue until reaching a Y junction. Take the right hand fork which is a track that is rough in parts, past a Casa on your L with blue domed roofs for a further 2.5km to where a track goes off down L to a ruin, a total of 3.4 km from the CV70. This junction is the start and there is parking for several cars. Note: After the blue Casa the track up to the start becomes very rough in places but is passable. If it proves too rough for your vehicle there are plenty of spots to pull off, park and walk the rest of the way to the start.

Route Name: Torre d’ Aguiló & Raco de Conil Circuit
Route Description: A short, scenic, circular walk along the clifftops and a more gentle return. Cliff paths are steep and have many loose stones. There is minor exposure.
Directions: From roundabout outside Carrefour take road towards Leroy Merlin. Pass by Leyroy and go straight across at next roundabout signposted "Mercadillo" cross next roundabout and Follow this road to the beach front. Meet by Cafeteria Marina
Restrictions: Wednesdays only to allow for optional menu del dia
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times
Lunch_break notes: Optional lunch at a seafront restaurant. Whatsapp lunch booking at least one week before walk.

Route Name: The Bull Stroll - Bull Run but taken at a gentle pace
Route Description: Circular Route; from Fleix down thro' tunnel to Isbert's Dam. Climb steep 'shelf' to left of road and continue upwards for an hour. Swing round to Mozarabic Path leading eventually to Benimaurel, but leaving this path to descend the 'corkscrew' (If conditions allow). Then rejoin the path & onwards to Benimaurel. From there it is back to Fleix by way of the old road.
Directions: Park opposite the school in the new car park in Fleix on the CV718.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Description: A steady climb beside a barranco to the summit.
Directions: Meet at Naranjos School car park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A circular walk on marked paths passing Montnegre towards Boidix and returning via the steep Travessia del Maset.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)

Route Name: Coll de Rates via Serra de Besa & Barranc del Negre, Cami de la Pansa, Azagador de Mestre & Camí de les Passules
Route Description: An initial ascent on footpaths over the Serra de Besa, followed by via a steep ascent on a narrow and rocky path alongside Barranc del Negre, with some clambering over rocks, takes us to the Coll de Rates pass and mirador (viewpoint), with spectacular views over the Vall de Pop and beyond. From the Mirador Coll de Rates, descending via the Camí de la Pansa, and returning via Azagador de Mestre, and Camí de les Passueles.
Directions: From CV-750 in Jalon, turn into Camí del Cementeri (the road between the Cepsa petrol station and the Ferreteria Tot Util).  About 350m along Camí del Cementeri, on the left hand side, opposite the CEIP Serra de Bernia school, you will see a large gravel car park; park and meet here.
Restrictions: Not Wednesdays in term time; parking is in the school carpark and access is restricted.

Route Name: Javea Windmills & Torre de Gerro from Restaurante Almanacer
Route Description: A circular walk starting at the restaurant heading for the windmills, then cutting across the Plana down towards the Torre de Gerro, and back. Mostly on good tracks, but a little bit rough underfoot on the Plana.
Directions: Restaurant Amanacer
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: La Nucia Tossal Grau circuit (from Elian's British School)
Route Description: Scenic walk, splendid views, mostly on good tracks. Option to ascend Tossal Grau.
Directions: Elian’s School,Avinguda el Copet, 5, 03530
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: La Nucia, Azagador de la Barrinada & Tossal Grau circuit (from Elian's British School)
Route Description: Scenic walk with splendid views from Puig back to the sea. Mainly on good tracks. Option to ascend Tossal Grau, not included in stats
Directions: Elian’s School,Avinguda el Copet, 5, 03530.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: A Ramble Round the Jalon Countryside
Route Description: Circular walk from Jalon with beautiful countryside views. A flat easy start for 1km then a steady 3km climb ending with a gradual descent to finish the walk. Underfoot rocky at times but not difficult. Relaxed pace to appreciate the views
Directions: Car park under trees opposite Alleluya Bar at Tourist Information Office in Jalon.
Restrictions: Parking only available on Wednesday: Saturday is Jalon market.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A nice easy Almond Blossom walk. Mostly on good roads, with a little bit of dirt track.
Directions: Park opposite Cementiri Municipal
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Relleu Castell & del Panta Circuit (plus Gorge Walkway)
Route Description: A Circuit going via the Ermita Sant Albert & the Castell ruin, then incorporating part of the ‘Ruta del Panta’ G/W route to reach the dam, where the impressive gorge walkway is optional (small charge applies). Mainly straightforward paths & tracks, though there are a few short rough sections and a couple which are mildly exposed. Some sections are unmarked. Lovely countryside and good views.
Directions: From near Villajoyosa (junc 66 on AP7) follow CV-770 north through Orxeta. Turn L onto CV-775 to reach Relleu, park on roadside at edge of village, near the sports centre.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: The walk starts on good tracks and takes us to a ridge with spectacular views to the sea. This part of the walk is very rocky. The ridge leads to the Castell de Grandella. A short steep climb out and heading towards the beach at Granadella for lunch. All good tracks for the rest of the walk.  Although this is graded as a moderate walk (based on distance and elevation),  this is a challenging walk in places, due to the rocky terrain where some clambering and use of handholds is required, along with a good head for heights.
Directions: Meet close to Hipica Cañada del Sol

Route Name: Circuit from Castell de Castells on the flanks of Alfaro
Route Description: An easy way to walk up on the flanks of Alfaro for fantastic views of the Serrella range and the mountains nearer the coast. Paths, forest tracks and farm building access roads.
Directions: Approaching Castell de Castells on the CV720 immediately past the village sign double back to the R on a minor road. Follow this until you reach a fenced compound with bins on the RHS and a large building in front of you (the sheep farm) at a junction. Park on the L.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: The route starts with a moderate climb up to the Col del Cau which allows great views out to the coast, before dropping into the Marnes high valley. The second half of the walk gives you excellent views towards the Sierra Bernia as you undulate gently to the finish.
Directions: 1 km after Pinos restaurant on Benissa-Bernia road (CV749) take right hand junction just over bridge towards Marnes. Park after 200m.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Over rolling hills to the north to reach the Rio Gorgos. Heading back over a small hill. Then up tough steep slopes with awkward steps (which come late in the day) to Penyes Blanques summit & back along the undulating ridge to reach Senija Cross. Six tops in all on mainly good paths & tracks, though some are rugged. Through lovely varied countryside, with fine views.
Directions: From CV-745 at eastern end of village. Turn into Avinguda de les Corts Valenciana which by-passes centre. Park on road side near play area for small children which has sub station next to it & road crossing opposite.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Mix of established paths,road and partly rough footpaths leading to the summit cross of Senija passing through vineyards on the return.
Directions: Square next to church. LLiber village is in Jalon Valley on CV750 between Senija and Lliber. Ample parking on th south(downhill) side of the village (signed)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Variant on PR-CV 445 Sender del Seguli
Route Description: This is a slight variation on the marked Sender del Seguili. It starts with a climb to the water tank and a good view, before descending into a really pretty valley. After this there is a sustained climb through the woods before turning onto a balcony path. When this ends we drop down, before a sting in the tail climbing to another view before returning to Benidoleig.
Directions: Park on Carrer Racona in Benidoleig just up from the school. Meet by the side of the road.

Route Description: A circuit via a summit on the most northerly sierra of the Costa Blanca Mountain range. Using paths & variations of ‘Senderisme A Favara’. A varied route, over ridges, steep slopes, & descending via a Barranco. Two caves and the unique summit structure of ‘La Casa Del Guarda’. Some steep, rough terrain, with a few scrambly moves. Fine views of rocky summits and out over the Valencia plains.
Directions: From AP 7 junction 59, at roundabout turn R on N332. In centre of Favara turn R on CV-510, turn into 2nd street on the R ‘C Del Rei En Pere’, park on roadside. Adjacent to a square with fountain & cafe beside it.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: THIS IS A LINEAR WALK. IT IS ESSENTIAL TO CAR SHARE TO & FROM THE START. From the mountain's base, rugged paths lead over the summit & along the ridge via Casa de Biot & Crue de Denia. Descending Barranco de la Hiedra to Los lagos. Steep & rugged terrain throughout, in places scrambly & mildly exposed, with some spiky awkward limestone. Superb mountain terrain, views in all directions.
Directions: Los Lagos. km 6 on CV735 between La Xara (near Denia) and Javea. Turn into Los Lagos, then immediately left and park.

Route Description: An attractive moderate walk from Jalon Devesa , Barranc Negre Masserof all on good tracks,
Directions: Park and meet at Parking CEIP Serra de Bernia in Camí del Cementeri in Jalon.
Restrictions: Not Wednesdays in term time; parking is in the school carpark and access is restricted.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: This walk is named after the Riberers or labourers who used this track when harvesting produce. The start is a gentle 4km before starting to climb. most of the walk is on good tracks except rocky and rough underfoot near the peak of Serrellars.
Directions: On the roundabout in Benissa take the exit before the AP7 slip road (Partida Bonaire)signed Cemetery, after 150 metres turn left at sign, after 200 metres turn left at T junction onto Cami de Canor.

Route Description: A circuit from Lliber along the high route to Senja where we will walk through the town and return on the lower route and across the vineyards back to the start.
Directions: Public Car park in Lliber
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Simat to Cova de Patricio & Monastery Circuit
Route Description: A country lane then paths lead via a steep climb to reach and cross barranco Fondo. An optional visit to a cave. A balcony pathway with fine views. Paths then wind down to the western end of the town. Passing through it via fonts and an optional, though very worthwhile visit to the Monastery.
Directions: From roundabout on CV-600 at edge of town turn L onto CV-675 bypass. At roundabout turn 2nd R towards Barx. Turn 1st R over bridge then immediately L onto C' del Sol. Turn R and park on road side or car park on L.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Extended Bernia circuit Anti-clockwise from Restaurante Sierra Bernia
Route Description: A circular route of the Bernia in an anti-clockwise direction. The walk is on tracks and good paths and visits a fort and several fonts. It takes in fantastic views in all directions as you circumnavigate the Bernia.
Directions: From Jalon, take the CV749 and at a T-jnc after km 11 where the road turns L continue ahead to pass a large building (Restaurante Sierra Bernia) on your LHS and park on rough ground just after this on the LHS. From Benissa follow the CV749 until after km 12 reach a T-jnc and turn L, pass the Restaurante Sierra Bernia and park on the LHS.
Restrictions: Wednesdays only; avoid weekends / fiestas due to overcrowding on trails

Route Name: Sierra de Bernia Font, Forat & Fort (PR-CV 7) (from Casas de Bernia)
Route Description: A classic and very popular circuit around this rock bound ridge taking in a steep ascent with a little easy scrambling, a short “passageway” and a return half across the flank of the mountain with a ruined fort and classic mountain views of the subsidiary summits of Severino and Ovenga. Route involves a crawl through a short, low cave to emerge on the south face of the Sierra Bernia with views over Altea, Benidorm and beyond. Return via the old fort. Rough tracks and some scree underfoot.
Directions: At approxmately km 14 on the CV-749 Carretera de Bernia turn into Camí del Bancal Llarg, signposted for Casas de Bernia - on the left if you are coming from Benissa / Calpe, on the right if you are coming from Jalon.  Park where you can along here, but please do not use the restaurant carpark, and meet by the SL-CV 7 noticeboard, which is approximately 600m from the junction.
Restrictions: Not weekends / fiestas due to overcrowding on trails

Route Description: A pleasant walk with optional lunch at Casa Paco in village.
Directions: Car park through village of Abdet. From Guadalest towards Confrides approx 5 km past Beniarda turn right to Abdet. Go through narrow street to car park.
Restrictions: Wednesdays only to allow for optional menu del dia

Route Name: Penya Mica and Barranco de Carretes
Route Description: New Walk. Meeting point is At the junction of CV750/Camino Deposito direction Benissa from Jalon, Car share from here to the start point.  The  walk follows  forest tracks to just before Carretera Bernia. A stiff climb leads to Peña Mica top, then an unmarked uphill traverse to  El Penyot. From here a steep rocky 8m downclimb leads to a series of wider tracks over a plateau to an urban area then descends0 a bank of Barranco Carretes to the start.
X: X (route suitable for experienced walkers only)
Directions: At the junction of CV750/Camino Deposito direction Benissa from Jalon, Car share from here to the start point.
Restrictions: Car share to restricted parking area

Route Name: Barranco de Dalt (Galistero) and Clot de la Llacuna circuit
Route Description: Sustained scramble up barranco, then mostly broad track via a sunken llacuna (depression). This is a demanding route. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participate.
Directions: CV720, Benichembla-Castell de Castells road. Park at bridge 4 ½ km beyond Benichembla. Park at side of road, not below bridge.
Restrictions: Wednesdays only

Route Name: Ѧ Bernia East Ridge and Summit Ѧ
Route Description: Short scramble to summit. Impressive views. Fun return route. This is a demanding route. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participate.
Directions: On road between Pinos and Xalo/Jalon at km 11.6 take spur to south. Park near Bernia Inn.

Route Description: Bernia ridge traverse to west summit. A fine classic route with impressive situations and fine views. This is a demanding route. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participat.
Directions: On road between Pinos and Xalo/Jalon at km 11.6 take spur to south. Park near Bernia Inn.

Route Description: A popular circular route leading up and along a low lying ridge with extensive views down to the coast and inland to the local mountains with return down the eastern flank.
Directions:
Benissa .38.723557,0.027748 From N332 at south side of Benissa take turn to Jalon ( CV750 ) at approx km10 at LHS near info sign 
( Benissa municipal tennis ,piscina ,padel ) and park on layby.
Restrictions: Wednesdays only

Route Name: Tarbena circuit to Font d'Olbis - short - anticlockwise
Route Description: A delightful walk with constantly changing scenery along generally easy tracks and paths with a finish looking over Paso Tancat – a wonderful gorge.
Directions: From CV715 Tarbena / Parcent road turn into car park near childrens' play area in Tarbena
Dogs: Dogs by prior arrangement with leader only

Route Description: A walk in this pleasant valley, in part along side Riu Gorgos.
Directions: Car park off N332 at Correos, main road Gata.

Route Description: Easy walk with lots of stops to take in the views. Slightly rougher ascent to summit can be missed out.
Directions: From CV715 Tarbena / Parcent road turn into car park near childrens' play area in Tarbena
Restrictions: Wednesdays only
Lunch_break notes: Optional paella lunch. Tell leader at start.

Route Name: New Years Day Lleus Circuit Walk followed by a Picnic Party
Route Description: Bring Your Own Picnic Food & Drinks to celebrate the New Year. Bring folding chairs & table if possible.
Directions: From Benissa along the N332 towards Calpe, turn right after the bridge with sign posted Casa de Maco restaurante, then follow signs to Lleus and La Brisa. At La Brisa take a sharp RH bend to Lleus Plaza. If coming from the Altea direction it is illegal to turn left at the bridge, therefore you will need to travel towards Bennisa and turn round when it is legal and return to the bridge.

Route Description: A walk with a bit of everything. Nice leg stretcher start on scenic track, 2 hour barranco walk,into Vall dâ€™Ebo (for break before final push if needed), and pleasant ridge walk to end lovely walk.
Directions: On entering village take first right and follow road around edge of village, past bar Les Rogetes (old bar Oasis), left at refuse bins then right. Proceed out of village to the Col and park near the Bar/Restaurante.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Benimaurell circuit to Barranco del Infierno
Route Description: An interesting walk dropping down and returning from the Barranco del Infierno with a challenging and exposed path along and above the barranco for some 2/3 kilometers which requires a steady head and great care.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel; park in the large public car park on right opposite Bar Restaurante Jalisco.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.

Route Name: Ѧ Pla de la Casa from Quatretondeta Ѧ
Route Description: Climb up to the highest point on the Serrella ridge with fantastic rock formations (Els Frares), a huge nevera on the way and breathtaking views.
Directions: Turn left off CV720 in Facheca and drive on CV754 to Quatretondeta – park where you can before you enter the village.

Route Name: Ruta de los Ribereros de Benissa
Route Description: From Benissa Cemetary via Camí Vell de Valencia and Roca de la Salva to Font de la Mata before the ascending the steep and rocky track to the summit of Serrellars [432m] with magificent 360 views, and then descending via Malla Verde, and returning on rural tracks and roads.
Directions: Park and meet at the carpark of the Cementeri Municipal de Benissa.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Long steady ascent to magnificent views.
Directions: On CV720 from Parcent towards Castell de Castells, just passed km30, cross rio Jalon and park on far side of the bridge.

Route Description: Varied walk including Castell de Castells village, Barranc de les Foies and La Llacuna refugio. Climb up from cemetery on mozarabic trail to LLacuna refugio and back round to Castells.
Directions: As you enter the village take the second left (look for CBMW sign and/or sweeper directing traffic) and park at the cemetery.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: An excellent walk on the northern slopes of Aitana with superb views on a clear day and a surprising view of the Castle. High altitude so choose weather. Occasional snow. Tracks and paths not muddy on mostly obvious paths, 50% on forestry tracks. 10 minute each way optional scramble up to Castle, (not for sufferers from vertigo).
Directions: Follow the CV70 from Benidorm / Polop direction towards Guadalest / Alcoy ,after Benimantell near to Km28 turn L (signed Benifato ) soon after turn up 2nd RH street ( sign for Fuente Partagat on wall ) continue up this steep minor road to arrive at the Fuente /Font

Route Name: Javea Arenal to Cala Barraca & Cap Prim
Route Description: Summer Programme Walk starting at 8am. Linear walk from the Arenal beach at Javea to Cala Barraca, returning via Cap Prim. Terrain is a mixture of rocks, rocky paths and some tarmac. Beautiful coastal views. Bring plenty of water and banana / breakfast snack for a morning break.
Directions: Meet on the beach side of the free car park "Javea/ El Arenal aparcamiento".

Route Description: A walk with it all! Running water, wonderful views, a very short scramble into Castell de Borro, secluded valleys and in an area away from our normal haunts. All the ascent is before lunch. Lots of stops.
Directions: From the N332 Gandia bypass, take the slip road off signposted to L'Olleria and CV60, after about 6kms take filter lane at junction 32 to Rotova. Continue straight on and 250 metres after roundabout on Ave Jaime 1 turn into car park on the right.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Varied walk almost all on forestry tracks with short riverbed stretch and one mozarabic path.
Directions: Take the CV720 through Castell de Castells and past Famorca, Facheca and soon afterwards there is a turn to the right to the village of Tollos. Take this and just before reaching the village park on the right in the car park behind a small recreation area.

Route Description: We follow the quiet country lane from Adsubia through the terraces to reach a path which ascends easily but steeply to reach the col at Pla de Miserat. Now we follow the road over the col beside Miserat before descending past Benirama castle on tracks and again on mozarabic paths below this to reach a lower lane and return to the village.
Directions: Turn left at the last road going through the village of Adsubia (Carrer Principal) and park on the road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Alfaro Circuit and summit from Tollos Ѧ
Route Description: A moderate walk with steep ascent in great surroundings. Circular route along the barranco Malafi and then up a steep track to Alfaro summit with great panoramic views. Return down good tracks.
Directions: Take the CV720 through Castell de Castells and past Famorca, Facheca and soon afterwards there is a turn to the right to the village of Tollos. Take this and just before reaching the village park on the right in the car park behind a small recreation area.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Benifato Castle circuit from Font Moli
Route Description: This is a long walk on the lower north side of the Aitana range. It is mainly on very good tracks which allows you to soak in the beautiful scenery. It commences with a pleasant walk to Partagas with amazing views of Guadalest. Other highlights are passing through an interesting rock slide, a beautiful hidden valley and a scramble up to castle ruins. There are a few stretches on paved roads but the scenery relieves the tedium. Save this walk for a clear day.
Directions: Take the CV70 from La Nucia towards Guadalest. Pass the Km 34 sign and 0.7 km further on take the minor surfaced road going off L (sign for El Trestellador Restaurant) past a large house on the corner. Continue along this surfaced road ignoring road of left for 1.2 km. to a group of casas amidst trees and a trough, which is near the Font Moli Ondara. This is the start and there is parking for 3-4 cars with more room down road.

Route Description: Some good paths to start with but rough sections to the summit of Tossal Gran and Castell d’Aixa. Mozarabic trails back down towards the Font before a climb back over the main ridge which we follow back to the cars to complete a circular route.
Directions: Lliber is on the CV745 between Jalon and Gata. Meet at the rastro parking area (signed-P) in the village.

Route Description: Circular route towards Serella castle before turning along the flanks of Aixorta. Good tracks with stunning views followed by a short rough descent section to the Forat of “Africa”. Well defined tracks now lead across to Pla d’Alt and across the road uphill again before returning down a mozarabic trail to the village.
Directions: Take the CV720 from Parcent and Benichembla to Castell de Castells. In the village, immediately opposite Hotel Serrella (on the RHS) turn L. After 20 m. turn L again into Calle Jose Antontio and them almost immediately L again down a ramp into the signed parking area.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Forada Ridge and Circuit from Al Patro Ѧ
Route Description: Some tarmac up the valley and then steep ascent on good track to Benisili castle. Then along the ridge on rough paths before eventually reaching the Forada. From here a descent takes us along the flanks of the ridge on good tracks and some tarmac directly to Alpatro and a choice of two bars!
Directions: Drive up Gallinera Valley from Pego on the CV700 and through the outskirts of Alpatro. As you leave the village there is a road down to the right signposted to Benisili and Llombai. After a couple of zigzags this lead off to the right towards a planned new residencia. Park here.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A classic clockwise circuit of the Mediodia flanks, partly on yellow/white routes. Partly overgrown on steep paths in the morning with good paths later on. Fantastic scenery on whole route.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.

Route Name: Ѧ Mediodia Summit – Puntal del Morrut Ѧ
Route Description: Initially up a mozarabic path towards some old caves with paintings (not visited) and then a steep, interesting hunter’s trail up to the ridge and then on to the highest summit of the Mediodia ridge. Return via some mozarabic paths.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Murla Penya Roig long circuit Ѧ
Route Description: Up to the ermita and then steeply on rough tracks to the summit of Penya Roig. An exposed traverse takes us to a short (3m) exposed down scramble before following the ridge line west. Just above Benimaurell we descend and start our return on good tracks along the flanks of the ridge. The scramble can’t be avoided and provides the main entertainment for the day. A classic mountaineering day.
Directions: Polideportiu. Approaching Murla from East on the CV719, turn right on outskirts of village (signed). Large sports centre on LHS after about 1 km.

Route Name: Tormos to Isbert's Dam via Pla de la Costera
Route Description: A short level walk brings us to the foot of the Costera where we follow a slightly overgrown mozarabic trail steadily upwards for most of today’s climb. Once on the Pla we follow a rough track on the flanks of Mediodia before descending on a good mozarabic trail towards Isbert’s Dam which we reach for lunch. A gently undulating return brings us through the campo and back to Tormos.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Resingles ridge of Mediodia Ѧ
Route Description: A classic demanding mountain scramble not for the faint hearted. Mediodia rock ridge and summit. After an initial walk in there is a long and sustained moderate scramble up a ridge with two more difficult short “pitches” followed by a second summit. The descent route will depend on rate of progress on the day. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participate.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.

Route Description: From Beniali a walk down along the side of the valley on paths before climbing steeply up opposite Benirrama. Then along the flank of Mirant before descending on tracks and steep paths with a final flourish to cross the Gallinera back to Beniali. (NB - WiS description slightly different and starts from Benirrama)
Directions: Follow the CV700 W from Pego and through Adsubia until you reach the KM45 marker (on LHS). Turn R (signed Parquing!) here down a small lane and curve around to the R at the bottom to find a large new village car park.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Val d’Ebo to Col de Garga and return
Route Description: A traverse above and then in the Ebo which becomes very bouldery and involves some easy scrambling for 2/3 km. Then we ascend on a mozarabic path towards Pozo de Jueves de Dalt and join a steadily ascending track to just below Col de Garga. Now an indistinct mozarabic trail rises along the flank of Carrasca to the ridge which we follow before descending on a mozarabic trail back to the village.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: This is a beautiful walk which combines the old mule paths from Bolulla (that supplied the Castle and areas beyond) with a higher level circular walk. Both of these shorter walks can be done separately.
Directions: From Callosa d'en Sarria take the CV715 to Bolulla. Ignore the road into the village, which is opposite the bridge, and continue for a few hundred meters to the next road sharp up and to the left. 200 meters up is the Bar Era plaza with usually enough parking. If this parking is full there is plenty more back down and across the bridge on the other side of the river.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A circular walk including an old mule track up to a spectacular 360 degree panoramic view at the top of Penya de l’Or for a banana break then onto a lunch break at an equally spectacular stop on the Foia Selles and ending at the Bar Era in Bollula.
Directions: On CV715 just past Bollula village sign take first right over the small bridge then turn left with parking either side of road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A horseshoe route over 2 of Pedreguer's unwalked ridges. An easy track start leads on to a rough but clear path which improves as we progress before descending along a ridge line with open views of Montgo and Segaria.
Directions: From the CV732 turn in to Carrer de Mexic. Park as soon as you can or continue a few meters downhill and turn L into Carrer Josep de la Tona and park along here.

Route Name: Cueva de Tossal del Vaquero and Cocoll airfield
Route Description: An easy track ascent to the Cocoll airfield leads to a mountain path to visit a large rocky cave on the slopes of Tossal del Vaquero (es Crestall) before rejoining our outward track to descend to the cars.
Directions: The CV720 runs into the mountains from Pedreguer passing through Alcalali, Benichembla and arriving at Castell de Castells. Pass through the village and take the CV752 towards Tarbena uphill until you reach track parking on the RHS near KM7.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Vall d'Ebo and Back (Figure of Eight)
Route Description: Walk with lovely views along good tracks into the village and back down to Pego.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Name: Buddhist Colony Circuit from Rincon de Pepe
Route Description: Walk up Contador, Stiff climb to ridge of El Carrascal, followed by path walk past "Rooms of God".
Directions: From La Nucia drive along the new road CV70 towards Benimantell to the restaurant & bar of Rincon de Pepe on the RHS near Km 35 which is about 2 km past the house on the left with a big snail on the roof'. Park in the ample car park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Caballo Verde Ridge (west to east) Extended (the easier option) Ѧ
Route Description: A circular route to and along the ridge (from west to east) descending under Penyo Roig towards Fleix and back to Benimaurell.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel; park in the large public car park on right opposite Bar Restaurante Jalisco.
Restrictions: Avoid Fiesta de Sant Antoni del Porquet (around 17th January) as Campell has pig roast which blocks off main street.
Dogs: Dogs by prior arrangement with leader only

Route Name: Barrancos de la Canal and Cova extended clockwise
Route Description: A good workout in remote scenery with fantastic craggy views.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Description: Starting with a one hour gradual climb to the top. Almost all on good tracks, and some road. Taken at moderate pace.
Directions: Take CV700 from Pego, direction Planes and turn left to village at km 46.5. Turn right as you enter the village to parking area.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Caballo Verde ridge circuit - shortened version Ѧ
Route Description: A very pleasant walk up to and along part of the ridge. Some stunning scenery.
Directions: On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel. Large car park (The only one in the village) on right opposite Bar / Restaurante Jalisco
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A demanding excursion over and along the western flanks of the Caballo Verde ridge visiting interesting features normally unfrequented.
Directions: From Benichembla follow the CV-720 for a short distance until you pass the 80kph marker and just past this and opposite a house turn R down a tarmacked road. This weaves a little to cross the river bed (gravel surface) and then climbs up the hill before running out on a level section with parking for only 2/3 cars.

Route Name: Barranco Bitla and ridge and ruins of Santa Maira
Route Description: Scramble up an interesting barranco to visit a rocky cave /animal corral and return along a ridge with various ruins and some of the most spectacular views of mountain ranges and rock formations from a low level walk.
Directions: Immediately before entering village of Castell de Castells from direction of Benichembla turn sharp R downhill past old washhouse , continue and park near sheep farm and bin compound

Route Name: The cave art and castle of Benirrama
Route Description: A meandering route visiting the caged Rock Art (Pintures Rupestres) opposite the village before climbing to the castle. Wide ranging views throughout. Just one short steep climb (30m) on the return but otherwise on easy paths throughout.
Directions: Take CV700 from Pego, direction Planes and turn left to village at km 46.5. Turn right as you enter the village to parking area.
Restrictions: Avoid weekends / fiestas due to parking restrictions / difficulties

Route Name: Pla de Petracos and Alfaro Slopes
Route Description: A glorious walk high above the Barranco de Malafi with a tough ascent followed by easy return walking.
Directions: Follow the CV720 W towards Castell de Castells and look out for a significant building on your RHS – Villa Mercedes. Here turn R towards "Petracos" and continue to reach a layby on your LHS.

Route Name: Ѧ Castell de Castells circuit East – Extended Ѧ
Route Description: A circular walk on Mozarabic trails broad forestry tracks and paths. Great views on a clear day.
Directions: Take the CV720 from Parcent and Benichembla to Castell de Castells. In the village, immediately opposite Hotel Serrella (on the RHS) turn L. After 20 m. turn L again into Calle Jose Antontio and them almost immediately L again down a ramp into the signed parking area.

Route Description: Costal walk with interesting ups and downs with beach visit and visit to ruins of costal defence castle.
Directions: From the N332 (between kilometre 181 and 182) take the CV740 to Teulada. Go straight ahead at the 1st roundabout. At the 2nd roundabout exit left towards the roundabout with the metal fish. At this roundabout go straight ahead and take the duel carriageway through Teulada. At the end of the shopping area look carefully for the sharp turning off left which is the continuation of the CV740 to Benitatxell. Go through Benitatxell following signs to Javia. Just before leaving the town turn right to Cumbre Del Sol. Go up on this road and then follow signs to HIPCA BAR. Park where the road turns sharp left and an unpaved track goes straight ahead. The walk begins here.

Route Description: A short walk on roads then ascend Barranco del Cau. We walk up the spectacular Barranco following an old water supply pipe and pass small concrete huts which helped restrict the flow. Once out of the Barranco we ascend to the summit of Cau followed by the long gradual descent along the ridge which provide excellent views all round. An alternative is to ascend via the Barranco Carretes if very wet.
Directions: Meet on road leading up to Lady Elizabeth school approximately 300m east of Venta Roja restaurant on CV750 Jalon - Benissa road.

Route Name: Ѧ Cavall Summit from Pego Ѧ
Route Description: Small amount on roads but mainly on marked paths albeit a short stretch of path is a little rocky under foot. The final section to the summit and back is ""off piste"", rocky in parts and a little scratchy.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.

Route Name: Col de Miserat from Vall d'Ebo
Route Description: A pleasant circuit virtually all marked Y/W.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)

Route Name: Cordilleras & Almadic Rim Circuit, Cocoll & El Mirabo
Route Description: This walk contours around the "Rim" circuit of Cordilleras and the Almadic Valley. Starting in Benichembla with an ascent by road before joining a wonderful path providing beautiful views and crossing many barrancos that brings us to the head of the valley to Cocoll. From here we follow the North side of the Almadic valley and eventually descend to Benichembla via the north side of El Mirabo.
Directions: Bar Bon Aire, Benichembla on CV720 between Parcent and Castell de Castells

Route Description: A mix of promenade and track walk to Torre del Gerro and the “Abandoned Village”. Beautiful coastal and mountain views.
Directions: Car park beside Bar Helios, Calle Fenix, Les Rotes. On the Denia to Javea coastal road CV736, pass the “Marina de Denia” on your left. A further 1.3km at next roundabout, take 2nd exit signposted Les Rotes. After 130m take first left signposted to Restaurant “El Farallo” onto Camino Badia. Continue to end of road to Bar Helios. Turn right and park.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: High level walk up to Cocoll fireplane landing strip and pleasant return on fire tracks back to Benichembla.
Directions: Drive from Parcent towards Benichembla on the CV-720 and after the Km 35 sign, just before the village, continue across the bridge and take the first road sharp up left. Drive approx 1.1 km and park by riverbed.

Route Description: A very pleasant ridge walk to the summit and return via barranco de les Cadiretes. Spectacular views of Jalon Valley and the coast.
Directions: Between Jalon and Benissa,38.730041, 0.01075 on the CV750, (km8) opposite Venta Roja Restaurante
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Starts with 15 minutes on very quiet roads. Then a stiff, off-road ascent of 200m over about 1km with one or two lulls. Views? Of course! Some tricky underfoot conditions in the first off-road half. Descent to lunch spot in abandoned campsite. Then, a less taxing ascent after lunch on mostly good track. Main descent along a zig-zagging path with some steps, onto quiet road for about 1km. Next, a well-trodden barranco for about 20 mins, returning us to the cars.
Directions: Approaching from Denia on the CV700 at the Coop petrol station turn R at the roundabout.  Proceed over 2 more roundabouts and at a T-jnc turn L.  Proceed past Mercadona on your LHS and take the next R into Via Pista.  Proceed for 1.15km approx., turn sharp left, staying on Via Pista. Starting point is about 350m further down this road.

Route Description: Gradual climb up to the Urbanisation of Aldea de las Cuevas on rocky paths, then onto road and track to the very top. Tossal Verde. Descent mostly on good tracks but the last 20 minutes quite steep to the village.
Directions: In Benidoleig exit the roundabout right, between the Farmacia and Grupo Marco to continue up the road to the Ayuntamiento.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ruta de les Fonts de Parcent
Route Description: Circular walk on footpaths, rural tracks and roads, through the countryside of Parcent, taking in the various "fonts" or "fuentes" en route.
Directions: From Alcalalí, take the CV-720 towards Parcent. On the outskirts of the village of Parcent (approx km 41.8), take the turning on the right (Camí de les Saleres), which will take you around, rather than through, Parcent.  After 300m, turn left into Camí de la Costera, and after a further 500m, at the T junction, turn left into Costera de la Font.  Parking Costera de la Font is about 100m along this road on the left; park and meet here.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Ruta de les Fonts de Parcent
Route Description: Circular walk on footpaths, rural tracks and roads, through the countryside of Parcent, taking in the various "fonts" or "fuentes" en route.
Directions: Bar/Restaurante Piscina. From Parcent take CV715 (Rates to Tarbena road) for about 1 km. Car park on right.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Extended Serrella castle circuit from the south
Route Description: Original description too long. Must be amended to 400 characters or less. Please see WalksinSpain write up for current description.
Directions: From Callosa d' en Saria: Drive towards Guadalest on the CV 755 for 10 km to a side road going down R to the dam. Drive across the dam and continue on surfaced road for approx 4 km to a T-junction. Turn R up surfaced road, (ignoring road off R), for approx 0.6 km to a track going off left just past a large â€˜Deputacion De Alicanteâ€™ sign. Turn left on to this track which is well surfaced but very narrow. Continue up until reaching a ruin on LHS and park.

Route Description: A demanding mountain day with panoramic views and interesting features, now in a slightly different set up to avoid the sections with a lot of burned trees, but the main parts are unchanged from the previous version of this walk.
Directions: Coming from the south (Orba) on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L (signposted to Costera del Moll) into Calle Pozo. Take the next L (Carrer Val de Llaguart) and then take the 2nd turn on the RHS just after the bins. Drive to the end opposite a plaza and turn L into Avenguda Joan Carles I. Drive a few hundred metres along this and park in the large car park on the LHS opposite the public piscina.

Route Description: N side of the Sierra de Serrella, steep climb to Font Roja, at head of Barranco Hondo. Below summit of Pla de la Casa to head of Barranco del Moro. Passing below Pico de Serrella then final climb to Malla del Llop ridge. Ridge to summit of Pico de Serrella then descend to snow well. Mule path zig zags steeply down to village of Famorca. Finally good leg stretcher along track back to Facheca.
Directions: Take the CV720 from Castells de Castells to Facheca/Fageca. . Pass through village, turning off L at the sign for Quatretondeta. Drive approx. 300 meters down the road and park on the L by tennis/sports club . The walk starts here.

Route Description: A circular walk from Lleus Ermita to Pinos Ermita on good tracks/roads.
Directions: Lleus Emita. From Benissa along the N332 towards Calpe, turn right after the bridge with sign posted Casa de Maco restaurante, then follow signs to Lleus and La Brisa. At La Brisa take a sharp RH bend to Lleus Plaza. If coming from the Altea direction it is illegal to turn left at the bridge, therefore you will need to travel towards Bennisa and turn round when it is legal and return to the bridge.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Original description too long. Must be amended to 400 characters or less. Please see WalksinSpain write up for current description.
Directions: From La Nucia drive along the CV70 through Benimantell and on towards Confrides. Immediately after Km 23, just as you enter Confrides, take the inconspicuous LH turn, which leads up through the very narrow streets of the village. After approx 300 meters take the road going up L, signposted Puerto de Tudons & Font del Arbres. Soon take the R fork up and wind up along this surfaced road 7km to the Font. Ample parking.

Route Description: A delightful pre-lunch walk through easy paths, lanes and roads on the slopes of the Caballo Verde looking across the valley and out to sea.
Directions: From Orba following the town ring road follow signs to the CV718 towards Campell, Fleix and Benimaurell. Follow this road until just after the junction to Fleix. The cemetery is on the L just past the junction.

Route Description: Expect a bancale or two, but the views are worth it!
Directions: Approaching Sella by the CV770, from the south cross the bridge and continue up to the edge of the village, turn right onto a side road to car parks (signed) on the right in about 200metres. From the north drive through the village and just as you leave it turn left onto the side road as described above, to car parks on the right.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: Varied circular walk along the Barranc de les Foies and up to La Llacuna, mostly on good tracks, with a short riverbed section and a nice mozarabic path back down to the cars.
Directions: As you enter the village from the Benichembla direction on the CV720, take the 2nd left signed for the cemetery and immediately follow the road round to the left and proceed about 200m to the car park.

Route Description: A lovely walk over wide tracks, a short section of road and marked paths. The walk visits a nevera, a landing strip and the ruins of an moors village.
Directions: From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d’Ebo. Continue past Vall d’Ebo to Alcada de la Jovada and park on edge of village near the swimming pool.

Route Name: Ѧ La Safor circuit from Beniali Ѧ
Route Description: A tough day's outing over one mountain range to reach a second that is rough and unforgiving. However the top has volcano like characteristics and views N and W that are unparalleled.
Directions: NEW CAR PARK. Follow the CV700 W from Pego and through Adsubia until you reach the KM45 marker (on LHS). Turn R (signed Parquing!) here down a small lane and curve around to the R at the bottom to find a large new village car park (signed).

Route Name: Landing strip and nevera above Alcala de la Jovada from Vall d'Ebo
Route Description: Although described as a strenuous walk because of length and total ascent, with the exception of a tough ascent within the first hour and a steepish ""off-piste"" descent towards the end, this is a moderate walk, mainly on good tracks/forestry roads and well defined paths.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Description: A circuit up to a rocky summit. After a leisurely start there's a tough ascent to the first col. and on over the rocky and slightly exposed summit. Except for the summit the route is mostly on tracks and well defined paths with a short distance on quiet roads. Absolutely stunning views.
Directions: Travelling from Alicante to Alcoy on the A7 exit at junction 481 onto the CV827 to Agost. At approx. km 4.5 park on the hard-standing on the LHS of the road.

Route Description: A circuit up to a col. below the summit, around the back of the mountain to reach the other col. and back down. After a leisurely start there's a tough ascent to the first col. but the rest is fine. Mostly on tracks and well defined paths with a short distance on quiet roads. Absolutely stunning views.
Directions: Travelling from Alicante to Alcoy on the A7 exit at junction 481 onto the CV827 to Agost. At approx. km 4.5 park on the hardstanding on the LHS of the road. This walk is only suitable for walkers, who are capable of maintaining a ‘brisk’ pace for the full duration of the walk.

Route Name: Maigmo summit via Collado de Maigmonet
Route Description: A circular walk to the summit of Maigmo. The ascent requires some scrambling and care as there are many loose stones. Leave room between climbers in case any large stones fall below. The descent is steep and stony. Poles will be useful.
Directions: On Autovia A7 between Alicante & Alcoy, take exit for Agost (CV827). After leaving the A7 access roundabout turn very sharply right signed â€œCami de Serviceâ€. This road runs parallel with the Autopista in the direction of Alcoy. After 4km take asphalted road to the left towards â€œBalcon de Alicantâ€. Drive uphill for 1.8 km and park under trees near a road with a barrier pole to your left.

Route Description: An arduous walk that starts at Bolulla with a steep climb up a surfaced road offering fine view of the village. A little known old mule path continues the climb up to Foia Selles where spectacular views can be enjoyed. A short decent into the Barranco del Negra offers a little respite before climbing steeply once again to arrive just below the summit of Morro Blau.A short track walk followed by a no path, find your own way down, to below the Serra del Raco Roig. Fine views of Bollua Castle can be enjoyed from the path to El Collada. The walk ends with a relaxing walk down to Bolulla on sections of old mule paths.
Directions: From Callosa d' En Sarria take the CV715 to Bolulla. Ignore the road into the village, which is opposite the bridge, and continue for a few hundred meters to the next road sharp left. 200 meters up this road is the Bar Era plaza with usually enough parking. If this parking is full there is plenty more back down and across the bridge on the other side of the river.

Route Name: Ѧ Murla Penya Roja short circuit Ѧ
Route Description: A demanding rocky ridge ascent and scramble with paths, tracks and country roads for the return.
Directions: Follow the CV719 to the village and just at the entrance to the village there is a sharp RH turn signposted to Polideportiu. Follow this to the Polideprtiu (sports centre) and park here.

Route Name: North and South of Alcala de la Jovada
Route Description: A lovely walk over wide tracks, a short section of road and marked paths. The walk visits a nevera, a landing strip and the interesting ruins of Adzubieta – a deserted moorish village
Directions: From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d’Ebo. Continue past Vall d’Ebo to Alcada de la Jovada and park on edge of village near the swimming pool.

Route Name: On the trail of Al Azraq
Route Description: An historic walk taking in some interesting sights in otherwise ordinary terrain. Views into the Barranco de Malafi.
Directions: From the Orba to Pego road near Pego take the CV712 signed to Vall d’Ebo. Continue past Vall d’Ebo to Alcada de la Jovada and park on edge of village near the swimming pool.

Route Description: Circular walk with very fine and varied scenery. Generally straightforward but with a few short steep & rough sections (there is an easier but longer alternative). The route goes over the Contador pass, continuing to & descending Passet del Golero, over Col de Basses to reach Casa La Carrasca, passing above the Buddhist colony to cross a col on Sanxet, then traversing beneath the cliffs of “Rooms of God” & back to the Bar/Restaurant, for some well earned refreshment!
Directions: From La Nucia drive along the new road CV70 towards Benimantell to the restaurant & bar of Rincon de Pepe on the RHS near Km 36 which is about 2 km past the house on the left with a big snail on the roof'. Park in the ample car park. Please visit the bar for drinks etc, before and/or after the walk
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A good workout in remote scenery with fantastic craggy views.
Directions: Plaza del Metge Almela, above Pla de la Font, Paseo Cervantes Plaza.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: This is a walk that provides absolutely stunning views for the most of the day into the valleys on both sides of the Penyo. The modest 600 metre ascent rewards walkers with beautiful 360 degree views from the top of Penyo Mulero. Being at high altitude it can be cold and snowy in winter with only minimal shade in summer.
Directions: Take the CV70 from La Nucia towards Guadalest. Pass the Km 34 sign and 0.7 km further on take the minor surfaced road going off L (sign for El Trestellador Restaurant) past a large house on the corner. Continue along this surfaced road ignoring road of left for 1.2 km. to a group of casas amidst trees and a trough, which is near the Font Moli Ondara. This is the start and there is parking for 3-4 cars with more room down road.
Restrictions: The starting point can be busy at weekends.

Route Description: This is a walk that provides absolutely stunning views for the most of the day into the valleys on both sides of the Penyo. The modest 600 metre ascent rewards walkers with beautiful 360 degree views from the top of Penyo Mulero. Being at high altitude it can be cold and snowy in winter with only minimal shade in summer.
Directions: Take the CV70 from La Nucia towards Guadalest. Pass the Km 34 sign and 0.7 km further on take the minor surfaced road going off L (sign for El Trestellador Restaurant) past a large house on the corner. Continue along this surfaced road ignoring road of left for 1.2 km. to a group of casas amidst trees and a trough, which is near the Font Moli Ondara. This is the start and there is parking for 3-4 cars with more room down road.

Route Description: An attractive and pleasant walk from Senija using a mix of old mule tracks, good tracks, with one short semi-scramble towards the Cave and a short road walk back to Senija. Excellent all round views of the coast and Jalon valley from the Cross and ridge at the summit of Les Basetes.
Directions: Ave Cortes Valencia on new wide road to back of Senija. From Benissa fork right at beginning of village; from Lliber double back left at end of village and park anywhere legal on wide road.
Lunch_break notes: Optional lunch in Senija at the end of the walk, please advise names to the leader at least 4 days ahead.

Route Name: Pinos Marnes Barranco del Baron Sella de Cau Circuit
Route Description: Walk through a barranco to Refugio Marnes and then onto the impressive Barranco Del Baron which ends at an old well and ruin. This is followed by an ascent, flat path and steep climb up to the saddle below the Cau. Long path back with excellent views. Small section near the end off piste.
Directions: From Calpe take the N332 towards Benissa. Before reaching Benissa , 750 meters after the KM 175 post, turn L, signposted Jalon, (CV750). In 100 meters again take the LH road signposted Pinos, (CV749). Drive 8 km to Pinos Restaurant on your RHS. From the 19 km post in Pinos drive 700meters to a bridge. Cross the bridge and immediately turn R onto surfaced road and park (Walk ends here).

Route Description: An undulating ramble on good paths in the valleys between Pinos and the Bernia.
Directions: Coming from Benissa on the CV749 Benissa to Bernia road. Pass through Pinos towards Bernia. 1km after the Pinos restaurant take the road to Marnes just after crossing the bridge. Park after 200m.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Pinos, Marnes and Sella de Cau Circuit
Route Description: A very pleasant walk in fairly level, upland “karst” type scenery, including an old mule path through a barranco, short stretches of track, and long improved goat paths among undulating hills with mountains in the background. A sharp climb to the saddle below Cau from where there is the opportunity of a short climb to its summit. Then continuing along short tracks and a long path down to the CV749 and car(s). The views are excellent and the wildflowers in spring and early summer fascinating. For those making a long day of it a visit to the Iris Garden in the middle of the walk is rewarding in April to June when it is at its best. (Opens April 1st). A possible short cut is described at the end.
Directions: From Calpe take the N332 towards Benissa. Before reaching Benissa , 750 meters after the KM 175 post, turn L, signposted Jalon, (CV750). In 100 meters again take the LH road signposted Pinos, (CV749). Drive 8 km to Pinos Restaurant on your RHS. From the 19 km post in Pinos drive 700meters to a bridge. Cross the bridge and immediately turn R onto surfaced road and park (Walk ends here).759771E 4285706N. Alternatively, drive 200 meters to a bend A. Ample parking.
Restrictions: This walk is currently affected by the construction of a new wall shortly after point F making it difficult to complete.

Route Name: Ѧ Pla de la Casa circuit from Facega Ѧ
Route Description: A straightforward way of visiting one of the Costa Blanca's highest ridges.
Directions: From Castell de Castells follow the CV720 through Famorca and arrive at Facega. Park along the main road.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at rear at all times

Route Name: Ѧ Pla de la Casa circuit from the south Ѧ
Route Description: This is a strenuous walk, definitely not for walkers seeking a flat and easy path, but the effort is rewarded by wonderful scenery and interesting terrain. It starts innocently enough with a pleasant easy stroll along the south side of the Barranc del Manecillo before dropping down to the riverbed. This is followed by a short but adventurous walk along the riverbed. The long climb up to El Collada starts on a nice path that zig zags up out of the riverbed to reach a track. This meandering track leads up to a path where the real ascent begins and some path finding skills are necessary. Next the route heads W and crosses the top of a ridge where wonderful views of the Barranco del Moro can be enjoyed. A steep but worthwhile climb leads to a deep nevera and a short scramble to the summit of Pla de la Casa. There is a pleasant plateau to cross before tackling the steep descent down to a cull. More path finding skills are needed to reach the pass of Les Bardals. From here a steep descent has to be negotiated on a very rough path before arriving at the track back to the start.
Directions: Take the CV70 from Guadalest towards Alcoy. Go through Confrides until at approx Km 19.4 and find a track off R. Turn onto this rough track and drive up approx. 0.4Km to reach a junction and park. Alternatively, park at the road and walk up the track to this junction.

Route Name: Ѧ Pla de la Casa from Facheca Ѧ
Route Description: The iconic and wonderful Pla de la Casa is the highest peak of the Serra de Serrella. The climb alternates from gradual to steep but is rarely punishing with constantly stimulating and changing views with a large Nevera adding additional interest. Mostly on good tracks, however some sections are loose underfoot. The views from the plateau and the narrow optional summit are magnificent.
Directions: Take the CV720 from Castells de Castells to Fageca. Pass through village, turning L at sign for Quatretondeta. Drive approx. 300 mtrs down the road to tennis/sports centre and park up on the L.

Route Name: Ѧ Pla de la Casa from the south Ѧ
