Those not wanting to do this summit will have a leisurely lunch and a guide to get you to the bar early! This is a demanding route. Please check with the leader in advance if unsure about your ability to participate.
Directions: Get to Campello via AP7 or N332. At roundabout on N332 in Campello near Big Mat turn to Busot CV 777. Just before Busot take CV 773 towards Busot and at next roundabout take CV 774 towards Jijona. After passing km 2 take right turn to “Partida Pla Cabeco 1”. Immediately turn left and follow road that parallels CV774 before it turns right. Continue on this road until it ends at a small car park near a walk finger-post

Route Description: A very pleasant walk for the main part around this rugged mountain with a tough ascent over rocky ground to the summit. A little scrambling.
Directions: Take the CV729 to Benimeli. In centre of Benimeli turn off the CV729 at brown sign “Pou de Baix”. Park near outdoor piscina.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A tough wander to remote summits with an easier return through quiet countryside.
Directions: From Jalon on CV745. From Pedreguer on CV720. Arriving at Alcalali from the direction of Jalon, Turn right at the T-junction at the top of the bypass, in the direction of Pedreguer. Almost immediately, turn left, just before two tall gate posts and the cemetery is on the left. From Pedreguer on reaching the edge of Alcalali, and shortly before the Jalon turn off look out for the two tall gate posts on the right of the road. Turn in here and park."

Route Name: Sierra de Sireret via Rio Ebo – In reverse
Route Description: A hard but pleasant walk with much over rough (but not too scratchy) terrain. A beautifully remote area with stunning panoramic views. Make sure you don’t miss it.
Directions: From the CV-712 go over the bridge into Vall d'Ebo and and park at the edge of the village  Avinguda del Marina Alta). (There is also a car park behind Bar L'Entra.)
Restrictions: Avoid weekend of Festa Fira del Perelló (around 20th November)

Route Name: Mediodia low level traverse from Tormos
Route Description: A walk up to the flanks of this ridge and a descent on Y/W footpath with fabulous views and scenery. Undulating on scrappy paths for a while with easier going later.
Directions: From Orba on the CV715 at the outskirts of the village turn L, C. Pozo. Go L into C. Vall De Laguart, then 2nd turn on the R just after bins. Go to the end turn L into Ave. Joan Carles1 Drive 450m past skate park on the L. Park on L in a field.
Restrictions: Wednesdays only
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A walk towards the dam on wide tracks, crossing the dry river bed to walk through the tunnel and returning alongside the river, through the orange groves and back to Tormos Restaurant.
Directions: Restaurant Tormos, Calle Santa Cruz,32.

Route Description: A circular walk from Pinos, up to Bernia Font then down back into Pinos valley. The walk eventually takes us – weather permitting - up a little-walked wide stream bed with interesting rock formations, before returning up the valley to the cars.
Directions: 1 km after Pinos restaurant on Benissa-Bernia road (CV749) take right hand junction just over bridge towards Marnes. Park after 200m.

Route Name: Celebrate the Sierras - Sierra del Penyal, Benimaurell.
Route Description: Please see https://bit.ly/2WwnDr3 for walk and lunch details and their respective reservations.
Directions: All 5 walks starting from Benimaurell.

Route Description: For full information click on this link. https://cbmwalkers.org/start-of-season-autumn-2022/ Pre-book meal for yourself (& any guests) by 26th Sept click https://bit.ly/3pnk84M. Walk options see below.
Directions: Meeting start point for all walks: Restaurant Piscina, Partida Rampudeta, 03792 Parcent. GPS coordinates : 38.7380364, -0.0750485

Route Name: End of Season Walks & Lunch with a variety of walks followed by an optional 3 course lunch afterwards at Restaurante Alahuar, Benimaurell.
Route Description: For walk details see below. The lunch booking form will be available towards the end of February, notification will be via the website. Please note that places for the lunch are limited, so book early to avoid disappointment once the event is advertised on the website. No booking is required for the walks.

Route Description: A pleasant circuit walk on the opening day of our Autumn walking season.
Directions: Meeting start point for all walks: Restaurant Piscina, Partida Rampudeta, 03792 Parcent. GPS coordinates : 38.7380364, -0.0750485
Restrictions: Opening Season Walk From Parcent
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A nice easy walk through replanted almond orchards. Mostly on good roads, with a little bit of dirt track.
Directions: Alcalali 38.754068,-0.040313. Restaurante Solana, Calle Los Naranjos 10 19, Alcalali.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Description: A ramble around Jalon countryside.
Directions: Jalon 38.744193,-0.017402. Car park under trees opposite Alleluya Bar at Tourist Information Office.
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: End of Season Walk Circuit from Benimaurell via Fleix - anticlockwise
Route Description: A very pleasant walk and an excellent appetiser before lunch. Although this is an easy walk as defined by taking less than 4.5 hours and with a total ascent not exceeding 200m the final section of the walk is, however, steep which will need to be taken at a slow pace with ample stops to rest. Some stunning scenery.
Directions: Benimaurell 38.773696 -0.127234 On entering village take first right (Blue P sign) and follow road around edge of village in the direction of Alahuar Hotel. Large car park (The only one in the village) on right opposite Bar / Restaurante Jalisco
Dogs: Dogs on lead at all times

Route Name: Start of the Season Walks & Lunch with a variety of walks followed by an optional 3 course lunch afterwards at Restaurant Almanecer
Eye of Montgo via Mont Putxol from Almacera resturant
Route Description: Taking in various points of interest. The route though a little convoluted is a nice way to approach the eye. Going via some Molins, a Civil War memorial & sections of woodland. Access into the interior of the cave requires scrambling but it is optional. Mainly good level paths though some are steep & have exposed views. Great scenery. Plus a very convenient cafe at the end.
Directions: From the CV-736 between Javea & Denia turn onto C' del Cap de Sant Antoni. In 400m turn R onto Cami Curt, immediately beside Restaurant Amanecer (it looks like their car park). Park at the rear at the side of the road.
